items.title: 2022年12月六级第1套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence“With the application of information technology in education, college students can now learn in more diverse and efficient ways.” You can make statements, give reasons, or cite examples to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
With the application of information technology in education, college students can now learn in more diverse and efficient ways. Not long ago, learning was confined to a fixed classroom and a single textbook, but technology has broken these limits and reshaped how we acquire knowledge.

On the one hand, learning has become far more diverse. Through massive open online courses, a student in a small town can now attend lectures delivered by professors at top universities, which was once unthinkable, and digital libraries offer millions of books and papers at the click of a button. On the other hand, learning is remarkably efficient. Thanks to AI-powered tutors, questions that once took days to solve can be answered in seconds, and search engines help us locate exactly the material we need. As a result, we save time and study with greater focus.

In conclusion, information technology has enriched both the variety and the speed of learning. Yet we should use these tools wisely, treating them as aids to independent thinking rather than substitutes for it.

items.referenceExplanation:
随着信息技术在教育中的应用，大学生如今能以更加多样、更加高效的方式学习。不久之前，学习还被局限于一间固定的教室和一本教材，但技术打破了这些限制，重塑了我们获取知识的方式。

一方面，学习变得远为多样。借助大规模开放在线课程，一个小城里的学生如今也能听到顶尖大学教授的授课，这在过去是难以想象的；数字图书馆更是一键之间提供海量书籍与论文。另一方面，学习也变得极为高效。得益于人工智能辅导，过去要花几天才能解决的问题如今几秒钟就能得到解答，搜索引擎帮助我们精准地找到所需材料。结果是，我们节省了时间，也能更专注地学习。

总之，信息技术既丰富了学习的多样性，也提升了学习的效率。但我们应当明智地使用这些工具，把它们当作独立思考的帮手，而不是替代品。

【第 1 段】照抄首句＋今昔对比亮中心。第一句 With the application of information technology in education, college students can now learn in more diverse and efficient ways. 逐字照抄给定首句， 锁住硬约束；紧接 Not long ago, learning was confined to... but technology has broken these limits 用今昔对比句承接首句、点明技术已重塑学习，落实了首段『照抄＋对比引出中心』的功能。

【第 2 段】并列＋例证咬住两个关键词。用 On the one hand... on the other hand 把 diverse 与 efficient 两个分论点分开；多样面举 massive open online courses 与 digital libraries，高效面举 AI-powered tutors 与 search engines，并用 As a result 点出省时专注的效果。每个例子都回扣了对应关键词，兑现了主体段『分论点＋例证撑满』的方法。

【第 3 段】总结呼应＋让步收分寸。In conclusion, information technology has enriched both the variety and the speed of learning 一句复述中心、首尾呼应两个关键词；随后 Yet we should use these tools wisely... rather than substitutes for it 用让步句补上理性提醒，落实了结尾段『总结加让步』的设计，也让论证更客观。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

论证技术让大学生学习更多样更高效

这是一篇首句续写议论文：给定首句已经把主题钉死为「信息技术应用于教育，让大学生 learn in more diverse and efficient ways」。所以你的任务不是自由发挥谈技术，而是用统一的中心去证明这句话——把 diverse（多样）和 efficient（高效）两个关键词分别落实、举出具体理由或例子，正文可 make statements, give reasons, or cite examples 来展开，但每一句都得为这两个词服务。

读者 · 语域

无具体读者的正式书面议论

本题是纯议论大作文，没有指定收信人或身份，读者就是阅卷老师。因此语域走正式书面语即可：不用称呼语、不用落款、不用口语缩略和网络用语；行文用完整句、正式连接词，保持客观说理的口吻。不必强行加戏虚构一个读者。

中心立意

技术从多样与高效两面重塑学习

全篇中心紧扣给定首句：信息技术从「学习方式更多样」和「学习效率更高」两个维度，实实在在改变了大学生的学习，并在结尾提醒应把技术当工具而非依赖。中心一句话即： technology enriches both the variety and the speed of college learning。

要展开的要点

1. 多样：渠道与资源被打开对应关键词 diverse。要点是技术让学习不再局限于一间固定教室、一本教材——慕课 （MOOC）让小城学生也能听名校名师的课，数字图书馆一键提供海量书籍论文。用可见的渠道变化去证明『多样』。

2. 高效：省时且更聚焦

对应关键词 efficient。要点是技术压缩了学习的时间成本：AI 答疑把过去要花几天的问题几秒解决，搜索引擎帮你精准定位所需材料，从而省时、专注。用速度与精准去证明『高效』。

3. 收尾：理性使用不依赖补充要点，避免一边倒吹捧。承认技术是有力的辅助，但提醒把它当作独立思考的帮手、而非替代品，让论证显得客观、有分寸。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段照抄首句并亮中心

开头逐字照抄给定首句作主题句，再用『过去 vs 现在』的对比句点明技术已重塑学习方式，自然引出下文的多样与高效。

第 2 段两分论点并列论证

主体段，用 on the one hand / on the other hand 把 diverse 与 efficient 两个分论点并列展开，每个分论点配一个具体例子（MOOC、数字图书馆／AI 答疑、搜索引擎）支撑。

第 3 段重申中心加理性提醒

结尾段先一句话总结技术丰富了学习的多样与高效，再补一句让步提醒——应理性使用、把技术当辅助而非替代，收束全篇。

第 1 段首句＋今昔对比铺垫

正文以给定首句开篇，随后指出：过去学习被限于固定教室与单一教材，如今技术打破了这些限制、重塑了获取知识的方式，从而为下文的『多样』『高效』做铺垫。

今昔对比承接 · Not long ago, ___ was confined to ___, but ___ has broken these limits and reshaped ___.（⽤『过去局限于 …，但 …打破限制并重塑 …』承接⾸句、引出变化）

第 2 段多样与高效各配一例

多样面：慕课让小城学生也能听名校名师授课，数字图书馆一键提供海量书籍论文；高效面：AI 答疑把原本要花几天的问题几秒解决，搜索引擎帮助精准定位所需材料，结果是省时且更专注。两组例子分别回扣 diverse 与 efficient。

两面并列过渡 · On the one hand, ___; on the other hand, ___.（把两个并列分论点清晰分开，避免糊成⼀段）

举例支撑 · Through ___, students can now ___, which once ___.（⽤『借助…，学⽣ 如今能 …，这在过去 …』把抽象论点落到具体例⼦上）

结果衔接 · As a result, ___.（由例⼦推出效果，点明『⾼效∕省时』的结论）

第 3 段呼应中心＋理性提醒

先总结：信息技术丰富了学习的多样性、提升了学习效率；再提醒：应明智使用这些工具， 把它们当作独立思考的帮手而非替代品。

收束总结 · In conclusion, ___ has enriched both ___ and ___.（⽤『总之， …既丰富了…也丰富了 …』回扣两个关键词收尾）

让步提醒 · Yet we should ___, treating ___ as ___ rather than ___.（⽤『但我们应…，把 …视为 …⽽⾮ …』补⼀句理性提醒，避免⼀边倒）

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题 diverse 与 efficient 都要写实

本题最易失分是只写 diverse 或只写 efficient、或抛开这两个词去大谈技术弊端。达标要点是 more diverse and efficient ways 两个词都要有专门段落或分论点正面论证，每个例子都回扣其中一个词，绝不跑题去讲无关内容。

结构连贯三段各司其职＋并列词分面

本题达标要点是首段承接首句、主体段用 on the one hand / on the other hand 把两面清晰分开、结尾段总结，不能三段都在举例或糊成一段。易失分处是并列词缺失， 导致 diverse 和 efficient 混在一起说不清。

语言准确话题词块要用对不堆砌

本题围绕 technology、access、efficiency 等话题词块组织语言即可，达标要点是用词准确、搭配地道（如 attend lectures、locate the material）。易失分处是硬凑高级词却搭配出错，反而不如用对的常见词。

字数格式卡在区间内且首句零改动

本题硬性要求 write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，写完必须核对是否落在这个区间；同时确认开头逐字照抄了给定首句，这是最致命也最容易忽略的两条硬约束。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

把首句擅自改写

反面示例：开头写成 Nowadays information technology helps college students learn in various and effective ways.——这改了措辞、没照抄，直接违反 begins with the sentence 的硬约束。修正：老老实实用原句 With the application of information technology in education, college students can now learn in more diverse and efficient ways. 作为第一句。

空泛断言无支撑

反面示例：Technology is very useful. It makes learning better and easier. Everyone likes it.——三句都是口号，既不多样也不高效具体。修正：换成可见例子，如 Through massive open online courses, a student can attend lectures given by top professors, which makes learning far more diverse. 让论点有支撑。

偏题写技术危害

反面示例：However, technology also brings many problems. Students become addicted to phones and waste a lot of time online.——整段在讲弊端，与首句要论证的『多样高效』脱节。修正：本题只需正面论证，结尾若要平衡也只一句让步即可，如 Yet we should use these tools wisely，不展开成大段批判。

同义反复灌水

反面示例：Technology is good. Technology is really good. It is very very helpful for students to study well and study better.——反复堆同义词凑字。修正：把注水句换成有信息量的内容，如 Search engines help us locate exactly the material we need, so we save time. 既扩了字数又推进了论证。

items.title: 2022年12月六级第2套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “In an era of information explosion, it is vitally important to develop the ability t o think critically and make rational choices.” You can make statements, give reasons, or cite examples to develop your essay.You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
In an era of information explosion, it is vitally important to develop the ability to think critically and make rational choices. Every day we are flooded with news, advertisements and social-media posts, yet not all of them are trustworthy. Only those who can sift truth from falsehood are able to stay clear-headed.

There are two compelling reasons why this ability matters. First, information today is a mixture of facts and rumours, and a careless reader can easily be misled. Take online rumours during public emergencies for example: people who forward them without checking often spread panic. Second, the cost of a wrong choice has risen sharply; whether we are selecting a course, a product or a career, rational judgement based on reliable evidence saves us from regret.

Therefore, we should never swallow information passively. By questioning the source, comparing different views and weighing the evidence before us, we can turn the endless flood of information into a real advantage rather than a heavy burden. In the end, critical thinking is not an optional skill but a survival tool for the modern mind.

outline.content: In an era of information explosion, it is vitally important to develop the ability to think critically and make rational choices. Every day we are flooded with news, advertisements and social-media posts, yet not all of them are trustworthy. Only those who can sift truth from falsehood are able to stay clear-headed.

There are two compelling reasons why this ability matters. First, information today is a mixture of facts and rumours, and a careless reader can easily be misled. Take online rumours during public emergencies for example: people who forward them without checking often spread panic. Second, the cost of a wrong choice has risen sharply; whether we are selecting a course, a product or a career, rational judgement based on reliable evidence saves us from regret.

Therefore, we should never swallow information passively. By questioning the source, comparing different views and weighing the evidence before us, we can turn the endless flood of information into a real advantage rather than a heavy burden. In the end, critical thinking is not an optional skill but a survival tool for the modern mind.

items.referenceExplanation:
在信息爆炸的时代，培养批判性思维和作出理性选择的能力至关重要。我们每天都被新闻、广告和社交媒体帖子淹没，然而并非所有信息都值得信赖。只有那些能够去伪存真的人，才能保持头脑清醒。

这种能力之所以重要，有两个有力的理由。第一，如今的信息是事实与谣言的混合体，粗心的读者很容易被误导。以突发公共事件中的网络谣言为例：未经核实就转发的人往往会散布恐慌。第二，选择错误的代价急剧上升；无论我们是在选课、选产品还是选职业，基于可靠证据的理性判断都能让我们免于后悔。

因此，我们绝不该被动地全盘接收信息。通过质疑信息来源、比对不同观点、权衡眼前的证据，我们就能把无尽的信息洪流化为真正的优势，而非沉重的负担。归根结底，批判性思维并非可有可无的技能，而是现代人赖以生存的工具。

【第 1 段】照抄首句后接铺垫立场。首句 In an era of information explosion... 一字不差照抄，落实了 ‘照抄首句即破题’；随后 Every day we are flooded with news, advertisements and social-media posts 用‘亮明现状’句架铺垫，Only those who can sift truth from falsehood 用‘点出立场’句架把观点接出来。

【第 2 段】两理由各带一实例。There are two compelling reasons 用‘引出理由’句架开段，Take online rumours during public emergencies for example 用‘举例坐实’句架把第一条理由落到具体画面，Second... rational judgement based on reliable evidence 用‘递进第二理由’句架完成第二条并回扣理性选择，兑现了‘理由加实例撑主体’。

【第 3 段】回扣主题升华收束。Therefore, we should never swallow information passively 过渡到结论，By questioning the source... 收束做法，末句 critical thinking is not an optional skill but a survival tool 回扣首句主题并升华，落实了‘回扣首句再升华’。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

论证批判性思维为何重要

本题要求 write an essay that begins with the sentence，即用给定首句开头写一篇议论文；交际目的只有一个——论证在信息爆炸的时代，学会 think critically and make rational choices 为什么重要。展开方式题目已给：You can make statements, give reasons, or cite examples to develop your essay.，也就是可以摆观点、讲理由、举例子，三者选一或组合。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式议论

本题没有具体收信人，是纯议论文，任务只是 write an essay，所以无需称呼语、无需署名，也不必写日期。语域按‘面向阅卷人的正式书面语’即可：用完整句、用连接词、避免口语缩写和网络用语，但也不必强行拽生僻词到读不通。

中心立意

信息爆炸下批判性思维不可或缺

全篇中心一句话：在真假信息泛滥的今天，唯有具备 think critically and make rational choices 的能力，人才能不被误导、不做错选择——所以它 vitally important。

要展开的要点

1. 信息真假混杂易被误导

第一个理由：今天的信息是事实与谣言的混合体，不加辨别就容易上当。配例——公共突发事件中，未经核实就转发的网络谣言会引发恐慌。

2. 选错的代价越来越高第二个理由：无论选课、选产品还是选职业，选择的成本在上升，只有基于可靠证据的理性判断才能避免后悔。这一条正回扣 make rational choices。

3. 主动质疑与比对的应对

结尾落点：不被动接收信息，而是质疑来源、比对多方观点、权衡证据，把信息洪流变成优势而非负担。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段照抄首句并破题立场

逐字照抄给定首句作为开头，随后两句点明‘信息泛滥、唯有会辨别者才清醒’，把立场亮出来。

第 2 段两条理由各配一例

主体论证段：第一条理由（信息真假混杂）配网络谣言之例，第二条理由（选择代价上升）配选课选职业之例。

第 3 段回扣首句给出做法

结论段：提出‘不被动接收、主动质疑比对’的做法，回扣首句主题并升华为‘现代人的生存技能’。

第 1 段抄首句加信息泛滥铺垫

照抄 In an era of information explosion, it is vitally important to develop the ability 起的整句首句，然后写‘每天新闻、广告、社交媒体扑面而来，并非都可信’，最后落到‘唯有能辨真伪者方能保持清醒’。

亮明现状 · Every day we are flooded with ___, ___ and ___, yet not all of them are ___.

点出立场 · Only those who can ___ are able to ___.

第 2 段谣言之例与选择之例

理由一：信息事实与谣言混杂、易被误导，例证为‘突发事件中未经核实的转发引发恐慌’；理由二：选错代价上升，例证为‘选课、选产品、选职业需靠可靠证据的理性判断避免后悔’，回扣 make rational choices。

引出理由 · There are two compelling reasons why ___ matters. First, ___.

举例坐实 · Take ___ for example: people who ___ often ___.

递进第二理由 · Second, ___; whether we ___ or ___, ___ saves us from ___.

第 3 段主动质疑并升华为生存技能

提出做法：不被动接收信息，而是质疑来源、比对不同观点、权衡证据，把信息洪流变成优势而非负担；最后升华——think critically and make rational choices 的能力已是现代人的生存技能。

过渡到结论 · Therefore, we should never ___ passively.

收束做法 · By ___, ___ and ___, we can turn ___ into ___ rather than ___.

升华拔高 · In the end, ___ is not an optional ___ but a ___ for the modern mind.

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题全程回扣批判性思维

本题必须紧扣 think critically and make rational choices，不能写成泛泛的‘信息很重要’。达标要点：两条理由、结尾做法都要能挂回‘辨别信息、理性选择’这条主线，最易失分处是主体段跑去大谈‘信息技术的发展’而忘了批判性思维。

结构连贯三段分明路标清晰本题三段分工要明确：破题、论证、收束；段内用 First、Second、Take...for example、Therefore、In the end 串起理由与例子。失分处是通篇简单句、句间无连接，读起来像罗列。

语言准确主题词准确点缀

本题可用 sift truth from falsehood、rational judgement、reliable evidence 等贴合 critical thinking / rational choice 的表达提分，但每句都要保证语法正确；失分处是为了炫词把句子写崩、或中式直译。

字数格式卡在150到200且抄准首句

本题硬性要求 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，不足或超出都扣分；格式上还要确保首句一字不差照抄。最易失分处是写嗨了超过上限、或为达下限反复重复同一句话。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

改写首句

反面示例把首句改成‘Nowadays, thinking critically is very important in the information age.’——擅自改写、还漏了‘理性选择’，直接偏离要求。修正：原样照抄‘In an era of information explosion, it is vitally important to develop the ability to think critically and make rational choices.’作为第一句。

泛谈信息重要

反面示例整段写‘Information is everywhere and it makes our life convenient.’，通篇夸信息之便， 却不提辨别与选择。修正：改成‘Because information today mixes facts with rumours, only those who think critically can avoid being misled.’，把落点拉回批判性思维。

只喊口号无例

反面示例‘We must think critically. It is very important. Everyone should do it.’三句都是口号、无一例证。修正：补一个具体例子‘During public emergencies, people who forward unverified rumours often spread needless panic.’让理由落地。

重复注水凑数

反面示例连写‘Critical thinking is important. Thinking critically really matters a lot. It is truly important to think in a critical way.’三句同义重复灌水。修正：删繁就简为一句并接理由‘Critical thinking matters because it helps us tell truth from falsehood.’，把省下的字数用来展开例子。

items.title: 2022年12月六级第3套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence“Today increasing importance is being attached to cultivating college students'team spirit.” You can make statements, give reasons, or cite examples to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
Today increasing importance is being attached to cultivating college students' team spirit. Both universities and future employers have realized that few achievements today are the work of a single hand, so this quality truly deserves our attention.

There are convincing reasons behind this trend. First, almost every modern task, from a laboratory experiment to a business start-up, demands that people with different strengths pool their efforts; without cooperation, even talented individuals can accomplish little. Second, working in a team teaches students to communicate patiently, respect different opinions, and share responsibility, all of which are qualities that textbooks alone can never provide. A student who once relied only on personal effort, for instance, may finally learn to trust others after completing a group project together.

For these reasons, team spirit should never be treated as something optional. Colleges ought to design more group tasks, and students themselves should step out of their comfort zones and embrace cooperation, because it is teamwork that turns scattered abilities into real strength.

outline.content: Today increasing importance is being attached to cultivating college students' team spirit. Both universities and future employers have realized that few achievements today are the work of a single hand, so this quality truly deserves our attention.

There are convincing reasons behind this trend. First, almost every modern task, from a laboratory experiment to a business start-up, demands that people with different strengths pool their efforts; without cooperation, even talented individuals can accomplish little. Second, working in a team teaches students to communicate patiently, respect different opinions, and share responsibility, all of which are qualities that textbooks alone can never provide. A student who once relied only on personal effort, for instance, may finally learn to trust others after completing a group project together.

For these reasons, team spirit should never be treated as something optional. Colleges ought to design more group tasks, and students themselves should step out of their comfort zones and embrace cooperation, because it is teamwork that turns scattered abilities into real strength.

items.referenceExplanation:
如今，培养大学生的团队精神正受到越来越多的重视。无论是高校还是未来的雇主都已意识到，当今很少有成就是靠一个人完成的，因此这一素养确实值得我们关注。

这一趋势背后有令人信服的理由。第一，从实验室实验到创业，几乎每一项现代任务都需要拥有不同专长的人合力；没有合作，即使有才华的个人也难有作为。第二，在团队中协作能教会学生耐心沟通、尊重不

同意见、分担责任，这些都是仅凭课本永远学不到的素养。举例来说，一个曾经只靠个人努力的学生，在共同完成一次小组项目后，或许终于学会了信任他人。

因此，团队精神绝不该被当成可有可无的东西。高校应当设计更多的小组任务，学生自己也应走出舒适区、拥抱合作，因为正是团队合作把分散的能力汇聚成真正的力量。

【第 1 段】抄首句＋点题过渡落地。本段第一句 'Today increasing importance is being attached to cultivating college students' team spirit.' 逐字照抄给定首句、不加引号，守住硬门槛；紧接 'Both universities and future employers have realized that...' 套用了'点题过渡'句架，一句话补出'谁在重视、为什么'，避免开头只剩孤零零一句首句。

【第 2 段】分点＋举例把理由写透。用 'First... Second...' 落实'分点列举'句架，两条理由界限分明；'without cooperation, even talented individuals can accomplish little' 用'无之则不立'句架强化必要性；'A student who once relied only on personal effort, for instance...' 用'举例过渡'句架把抽象理由坐实，正是题干鼓励的 give reasons 与 cite examples 结合。

【第 3 段】重申＋对策有力收尾。'For these reasons, team spirit should never be treated as something optional.' 套用'收束重申'句架把前文收拢；'Colleges ought to..., and students themselves should...' 套用'对策呼吁'句架，落到学校与学生两方的具体行动上，比'总之很重要'更有内容，也把字数稳稳补进达标区间。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

顺首句展开团队精神议论文

本题要求 write an essay that begins with the sentence，且给定的首句已点明主题——重视培养大学生的团队精神。所以任务被钉死为：不是自由命题，而是顺着这句已定的论点，用 make statements, give reasons, or cite examples 三种方式把'为什么该重视、怎么培养'讲清楚，写成一篇一以贯之的议论短文。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

题目只说 write an essay，没有设定具体收信人或情境，因此没有称呼、没有署名，读者就是阅卷老师。语域取正式书面语：用完整句、连接词清晰、避免口语缩略和网络用语，但也不必堆砌生僻大词，把观点讲顺、讲准最重要。

中心立意

团队精神既重要又可培养

承接首句给定的论点，把中心明确为：培养大学生团队精神之所以被日益重视，是因为它既是现代协作社会的刚需，又能通过校园里的集体任务真正养成——所以它值得学校设计、值得学生投入。

要展开的要点

1. 现代任务离不开协作

第一条理由：从实验室课题到创业项目，几乎每件现代任务都需要不同专长的人合力，单打独斗即使有才也难成事——这对应题干提示的 give reasons。

2. 团队锻炼沟通与责任第二条理由：在团队中协作，能学会耐心沟通、尊重不同意见、分担责任，这些是课本教不了的素养。此处再嵌一个具体小例子佐证，用上 cite examples 这一展开方式。

3. 呼吁学校与学生共同投入

收束落点：既然团队精神如此重要，就不该被当成可有可无——学校应多设计小组任务，学生应主动走出舒适区拥抱合作。用对策式呼吁回扣中心、让文章有力收尾。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段抄首句并立论

逐字照抄题目给定的首句作为开头，随后一两句点明'为什么如今越来越重视团队精神'， 把中心亮出来。

第 2 段给理由并举例

全文重心段：用 First/Second 分点给出两条理由，其中一条再嵌一个具体例子，把'为什么重要'论透。

第 3 段重申并呼吁收束

重申团队精神不可或缺，给出学校与学生两方的对策式呼吁，回扣中心、有力收尾。

第 1 段抄首句＋点明重视缘由

照抄给定首句后，补充：如今学校和未来的雇主都意识到，很少有成就是靠一个人完成的， 所以团队精神这一素养确实值得关注，自然引出下文论证。

照抄首句起笔 · 直接把题⽬给定的整句作为第⼀句写下，⼀字不改、不加引号，写完⽴ 即回读核对拼写与标点。

点题过渡 · Both ___ and ___ have realized that ___, so this quality truly deserves our attention.

第 2 段两条理由＋一个例子

理由一：从实验室实验到创业，现代任务都需要不同专长的人合力，缺乏合作再有才也难成事；理由二：团队协作教会沟通、包容、分担责任；随后举例——一个曾只靠个人努力的学生，在完成一次小组项目后终于学会信任他人。

分点列举 · First, ___; Second, ___ ——⽤序数词把两条理由清楚分开。

无之则不立 · without ___, even ___ can accomplish little. ——⽤假设强调该要素的必要性。

举例过渡 · A ___ who once ___, for instance, may finally ___ after ___. ——⽤ for instance 引出⼀个具体⼈物或场景。

第 3 段重申价值＋双方对策

重申团队精神不该被当成可有可无；呼吁学校多设计小组任务，学生主动走出舒适区拥抱合作，因为正是团队合作把分散的能力聚成真正的力量。

收束重申 · For these reasons, ___ should never be treated as something optional.

对策呼吁 · ___ ought to ___, and ___ should ___, because it is ___ that ___.

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题始终紧扣团队精神

本题要求 make statements, give reasons, or cite examples 都必须围绕首句给定的'团队精神'展开，理由与例子若滑向泛谈大学生活或人际关系即偏题，须把每一句都拉回团队合作这一核心。

结构连贯三段式配路标词

本题按首句立论—理由举例—收束三段推进，段内用 First、Second、for instance、 For these reasons 等连接词串联，避免句子堆在一起看不出层次。

语言准确稳用有把握句式

本题多用一般现在时陈述普遍事实，注意 demands that、each/every 后的单数，以及 pool efforts、share responsibility 等搭配；用熟练句式把观点讲准，比硬凑难句更稳。

字数格式守住区间与首句原样

本题限定 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，不足或超出都失分；同时首句必须原样照抄、不加引号，写完务必回读核对拼写与标点。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

改写首句或加引号

反面示例：把开头写成 As we all know, team spirit is quite important for college students today. —— 这既没照抄首句、又改了措辞。修正：开头必须一字不差写成 Today increasing importance is being attached to cultivating college students' team spirit. 不加任何引号。

跑题成泛谈大学生活

反面示例：College life is colorful; we make many friends and join clubs to enjoy ourselves. —— 通篇在谈校园生活，丢了团队精神这一核心。修正：改成 Working with classmates on a shared task teaches students to cooperate, which is exactly what team spirit means. 让每句都咬住团队合作。

只喊口号不展开

反面示例：Team spirit is very important. We must have team spirit. It is good for everyone. —— 三句都是空口号、无支撑。修正：改成 Team spirit matters because a group project succeeds only when members combine their different skills, just as a football team wins by passing rather than dribbling alone. 用理由加类比把观点撑起来。

结尾草草且字数失控

反面示例：In a word, team spirit is important. Thank you. —— 收尾空洞、还带口语化 Thank you，全文也可能不足150词。修正：改成 For these reasons, colleges should design more group tasks and students should embrace cooperation, so that team spirit becomes a real strength rather than an empty slogan. 既重申又给对策、又补足字数。

items.title: 2022年6月六级第1套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “Nowadays more and more people choose to live an environmentally friendly lifestyle.” You can make comments, cite examples, or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
Nowadays more and more people choose to live an environmentally friendly lifestyle. This shift is no longer a slogan but a set of daily habits that reshape how we eat, travel and consume.

Several concrete practices explain this trend. To begin with, many commuters now favour buses, subways or shared bikes over private cars, which cuts carbon emission and eases traffic. What is more, sorting rubbish into recyclable and kitchen waste has become routine in my own neighbourhood, so that plastic and paper can be recycled rather than buried. Take myself as an example: since I started carrying a cloth bag and a reusable bottle, I have thrown away far less single-use plastic every week. Small as these acts seem, they add up to a sustainable way of living.

As a result, an environmentally friendly lifestyle benefits both individuals and the planet. It saves resources, keeps the air cleaner and reminds us that a green future depends on the choices we make today. I firmly believe that when everyone takes one small step, the earth will thank us tomorrow.

outline.content: Nowadays more and more people choose to live an environmentally friendly lifestyle. This shift is no longer a slogan but a set of daily habits that reshape how we eat, travel and consume.

Several concrete practices explain this trend. To begin with, many commuters now favour buses, subways or shared bikes over private cars, which cuts carbon emission and eases traffic. What is more, sorting rubbish into recyclable and kitchen waste has become routine in my own neighbourhood, so that plastic and paper can be recycled rather than buried. Take myself as an example: since I started carrying a cloth bag and a reusable bottle, I have thrown away far less single-use plastic every week. Small as these acts seem, they add up to a sustainable way of living.

As a result, an environmentally friendly lifestyle benefits both individuals and the planet. It saves resources, keeps the air cleaner and reminds us that a green future depends on the choices we make today. I firmly believe that when everyone takes one small step, the earth will thank us tomorrow.

items.referenceExplanation:
如今越来越多的人选择过一种环保的生活方式。这一转变不再只是一句口号，而是一套重塑我们如何饮食、出行和消费的日常习惯。

几种具体做法解释了这一趋势。首先，许多通勤者如今更青睐公交、地铁或共享单车而非私家车，这减少了碳排放、缓解了交通拥堵。此外，把垃圾分为可回收物与厨余在我所在的社区已成为惯例，这样塑料和纸张便能被回收而非填埋。以我自己为例：自从我开始随身携带布袋和可重复使用的水杯，我每周扔掉的一次性塑料明显少了许多。这些举动看似微小，累积起来却构成了一种可持续的生活方式。

因此，环保的生活方式既有益于个人，也有益于地球。它节约资源、让空气更洁净，也提醒我们：绿色的未来取决于我们今天的选择。我坚信，当每个人都迈出一小步，地球终将在明天回报我们。

【第 1 段】首句照抄加点题句。首句 Nowadays more and more people choose to live an environmentally friendly lifestyle. 一字不改照抄，落实了『首句照抄后一句点题』；紧跟的 This shift is no longer a slogan but a set of daily habits 就是点题句，套用了『承接首句概括现象』句架，一句亮出中心。

【第 2 段】两抓手加个人经历落地。本段以 To begin with 引出低碳出行、What is more 引出垃圾分类，每个抓手后都补了好处（cuts carbon emission、can be recycled），再用 Take myself as an example 转入布袋与水杯的亲身细节，正是『抓手加细节加个人经历』的落地；末句 they add up to a sustainable way of living 小结回扣中心。

【第 3 段】因果承接加呼吁升华。As a result 承接主体推出结论，归纳其利个人利地球的价值，末句 I firmly believe that when everyone takes one small step 用『升华呼吁收尾』句架收束，兑现了『因果收束再升华』。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

议论环保生活方式这一现象

本题要写的是：以指定首句开篇，围绕 environmentally friendly lifestyle 这一现象，用评论、 例子或个人经历把它写清楚——You can make comments, cite examples, or use your personal experiences to develop your essay。一句话钉死：谈越来越多人选择环保生活方式这件事，讲它有哪些具体表现、为什么值得，而不是空泛地谈环境保护有多重要。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

本题是纯议论短文，Directions 没有指定收信人或具体身份，因此不必设称呼、不必落款；读者就是阅卷老师，语域用正式书面语即可：多用完整句与连接词，少用口语缩略与网络词。不要强行给它加一个不存在的收信对象，那反而是画蛇添足。

中心立意

环保生活方式正融入日常

中心立意：环保生活方式已不再是口号，而是一套正在融入普通人日常的具体习惯，值得肯定并推广。这一中心紧扣首句里 environmentally friendly lifestyle 的核心词，既回应现象、又给出评价，主体段和结尾都能顺着它往下写。

要展开的要点

1. 低碳出行减少碳排放第一个抓手：出行方式的转变——越来越多人用公交、地铁、共享单车代替私家车，直接减少碳排放、缓解交通拥堵。这是最容易举证、也最贴近考生生活的社会层面表现。

2. 垃圾分类让资源循环

第二个抓手：垃圾分类回收——把垃圾分成可回收物与厨余已在许多社区成为惯例，让塑料、 纸张得以循环利用而非填埋。用 recycle、sustainable 等主题词能提升语言分。

3. 个人经历减少一次性塑料第三个抓手（用个人经历落地）：随身带布袋和可重复使用的水杯，减少一次性塑料的使用。 这一条把 personal experience 用足，让论述有细节、不空喊。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段照抄首句并点出现象把指定首句一字不改照抄为第一句，紧接一句概括这一现象、亮出全篇中心：环保生活方式已成为一套日常习惯。

第 2 段抓手加个人经历展开

主体段：用低碳出行、垃圾分类两个社会层面抓手加一段个人经历（布袋与水杯），把环保生活方式的具体表现和好处写实。

第 3 段因果收束并升华呼吁

结尾段：用因果承接主体，点出这种生活方式对个人与地球的双重意义，并以一句呼吁收束升华。

第 1 段现象加中心：环保成日常习惯

照抄首句后，写一句概括：这种转变不再是一句口号，而是一套重塑人们饮食、出行、消费方式的日常习惯——既点出现象普遍，又暗示下文要谈的具体抓手。

承接首句概括现象 · This shift is no longer a slogan but ___ that reshape(s) how we ___.

亮出全篇中心 · Behind this change lies ___, which deserves a closer look.

第 2 段低碳出行加垃圾分类加布袋水杯

本段落三个内容点：其一，公交地铁共享单车替代私家车，减少碳排放、缓解拥堵；其二， 垃圾分类让塑料纸张得以回收而非填埋；其三，个人经历——自从随身带布袋和可重复水杯，每周扔掉的一次性塑料明显减少。最后一句小结回扣中心：这些小事累积成可持续的生活方式。

引出首个理由 · To begin with, many people now ___ rather than ___, which ___.

追加并列要点 · What is more, ___ has become routine, so that ___ can be ___.

个人经历举例 · Take myself as an example: since I started ___, I have ___.

第 3 段利个人利地球加行动呼吁

本段内容：点明环保生活方式既利个人又利地球——节约资源、让空气更洁净；再升华到绿色未来取决于今天的选择，以一句『每个人迈一小步、地球终将回报』的呼吁收尾。

因果收束归纳价值 · As a result, ___ benefits both ___ and ___.

升华呼吁收尾 · I firmly believe that when everyone ___, ___ will ___.

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题紧扣环保生活方式不跑题

本题切题的关键是全篇不离 environmentally friendly lifestyle：范文用低碳出行、垃圾分类、减塑三个抓手都指向这一核心词，并用了 use your personal experiences to develop your essay 允许的个人经历。最易失分处是写成泛谈『环境保护很重要』， 那就偏离了『生活方式』这个落点。

结构连贯三段递进加因果举例衔接本题达标要点：首段点题、主体展开、末段升华三段递进，段内用 To begin with、 What is more、As a result 把并列与因果接顺。易失分处是主体段罗列做法却不用衔接词，读起来像流水账。

语言准确环保主题词用准提分

本题若能准确用上 carbon emission、recycle、sustainable 等主题词，语言分会更高；但要用对搭配，别把 recycle 拼错或与 reuse 混用。谈普遍现象用一般现在时， 谈个人经历用现在完成时，时态别乱跳。

字数格式首句照抄且卡住上下限

本题是硬性区间 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，且要求 begins with the sentence 指定的首句必须原样出现在开头。自查时确认首句一字未改、词数在下限之上、上限之内即可，切忌超界。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

把首句改写成自己的话

反面示例（把首句改写）：Today, an increasing number of people prefer a green way of life. —— 意思对，但改了词就算没照抄、直接判偏题。修正：老老实实把第一句写成 Nowadays more and more people choose to live an environmentally friendly lifestyle. 一字不动。

通篇只说环保很重要

反面示例（空喊口号）：Protecting the environment is very important. We should all protect it. It is good for everyone. —— 三句都是口号、零例子。修正：换成具体抓手，如 many people now take the subway instead of driving, which cuts carbon emission. 用做法和好处代替空话。

重复堆砌同一句凑数

反面示例（注水）：Protecting the environment is our duty, and it is our duty to protect the environment, and everyone must protect the environment. —— 一个意思绕三遍。修正：删去重复，替换为具体内容，如 Sorting rubbish at home lets plastic and paper be recycled rather than buried. 让每句都带新信息。

套无关万能开头偏题

反面示例（套模板）：With the rapid development of society and economy, competition is becoming fiercer than ever. —— 与环保生活方式毫无关系，还挤掉了必须照抄的首句位置。修正：直接用指定首句开篇，第二句紧扣环保生活方式点题，不留模板套话的位置。

items.title: 2022年6月六级第2套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “Nowadays more and more people keep learning new skills to adapt to a fast-changing world.” You can make comments, cite examples, or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
Nowadays more and more people keep learning new skills to adapt to a fast-changing world. This trend, in my view, is not a passing fashion but a wise and even necessary response to the age we live in.

The most obvious reason lies in the speed of technological change. Skills that guaranteed a stable job ten years ago may become outdated overnight, so those who stop learning risk being replaced. Take my cousin as an example. As a traditional accountant, she felt threatened when her company introduced financial software, yet instead of complaining she spent her evenings mastering data analysis. Within a year she was promoted rather than laid off. Her experience convinces me that continuous learning is what keeps a person competitive. Beyond the workplace, learning also enriches our daily life and broadens our horizons.

In conclusion, keeping pace with a changing world through lifelong learning is no longer optional but essential. Rather than fearing change, we should treat every new skill as a bridge to a wider future. I firmly believe that whoever embraces new skills today will stand firm tomorrow.

outline.content: Nowadays more and more people keep learning new skills to adapt to a fast-changing world. This trend, in my view, is not a passing fashion but a wise and even necessary response to the age we live in.

The most obvious reason lies in the speed of technological change. Skills that guaranteed a stable job ten years ago may become outdated overnight, so those who stop learning risk being replaced. Take my cousin as an example. As a traditional accountant, she felt threatened when her company introduced financial software, yet instead of complaining she spent her evenings mastering data analysis. Within a year she was promoted rather than laid off. Her experience convinces me that continuous learning is what keeps a person competitive. Beyond the workplace, learning also enriches our daily life and broadens our horizons.

In conclusion, keeping pace with a changing world through lifelong learning is no longer optional but essential. Rather than fearing change, we should treat every new skill as a bridge to a wider future. I firmly believe that whoever embraces new skills today will stand firm tomorrow.

items.referenceExplanation:
如今，越来越多的人不断学习新技能，以适应这个快速变化的世界。在我看来，这一趋势并非一时的时髦，而是对我们所处时代明智乃至必要的回应。

最明显的原因在于技术变化之快。十年前还能保住一份稳定工作的技能，可能一夜之间就过时了，因此停止学习的人有被取代的风险。以我的表姐为例。作为一名传统会计，当公司引进财务软件时她感到了威胁，但她没有抱怨，而是利用晚上钻研数据分析。不到一年，她不降反升，得到了晋升。她的经历让我确

信，持续学习正是让一个人保持竞争力的关键。除了职场之外，学习也丰富着我们的日常生活、开阔着我们的眼界。

总而言之，通过终身学习跟上不断变化的世界，已不再是可有可无的选择，而是必需。与其惧怕变化，不如把每一项新技能都当作通往更广阔未来的桥梁。我坚信，今天拥抱新技能的人，明天必能站稳脚跟。

【第 1 段】照抄首句后表态。本段第一句 Nowadays more and more people... 完全逐字照抄题目给定首句，满足首句续写的硬性要求;第二句 This trend, in my view, is not a passing fashion but a wise and even necessary response 用'不是A而是B'的句架把现象句转成立场句，完成'抄首句＋亮立场'的功能。

【第 2 段】四步论证到位。本段按'理由加实例'方法展开：主题句 The most obvious reason lies in the speed of technological change 抛出理由;随后 Take my cousin as an example 用举例句架切入个人相关的具体故事;instead of complaining she spent her evenings mastering data analysis 用让步转折凸显正面选择;末句回扣 continuous learning is what keeps a person competitive，例子没有脱节。

【第 3 段】重申并升华。本段 In conclusion... is no longer optional but essential 换措辞重申中心， 不与首段重复;whoever embraces new skills today will stand firm tomorrow 用'今天…者，明天必…'句架把结论推向未来，实现'回扣中心并升华'，且只有三句，未超篇幅。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

首句续写的议论文

本题要求写一篇 an essay that begins with the sentence 的短文：开头逐字照抄题目给定的那句关于'不断学习新技能以适应快速变化世界'的话，再围绕它展开自己的论述，可 make comments, cite examples, or use your personal experiences 三者任选或结合。交际目的就是就'为何要持续学习新技能'表明立场并论证。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

本题没有具体收信人，属纯议论大作文，不需要称呼、落款，只需面向阅卷人使用正式、清晰的书面语即可。题干 you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay 也表明这是限时考场作文， 行文要逻辑显化、少口语，避免缩写和随意的俚语。

中心立意

持续学习是适应时代的必需

本文中心论点：在技术和职业快速更迭的今天，不断学习新技能不是可有可无的时髦，而是保持竞争力、适应快速变化世界的必然选择。全文都为这一句服务。

要展开的要点

1. 技术更新淘汰旧技能

第一个分论点从社会与职业角度切入：技术迭代太快，多年前够用的技能可能一夜过时，停止学习的人就有被替代的风险，因此必须持续更新自己。

2. 个人经历坐实观点第二个支撑点用一个具体的个人相关例子（当会计的表姐主动自学数据分析、一年后不降反升）把抽象道理落到实处，正好呼应 use your personal experiences 这一发展方式。

3. 学习超越职场的价值

补一个小要点收束主体段：学习不止关乎饭碗，也丰富生活、开阔眼界，让论证不至于只停在'保住工作'的功利层面。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段抄首句＋亮立场

第一段先逐字照抄题目给定首句，再补一句点明本文态度：这一现象是明智且必要的选择，为全文定调。

第 2 段理由＋实例论证

主体段给出核心理由（技术更新快、旧技能会被淘汰），并用一个具体的个人例子把理由坐实，最后带出学习的更广价值。

第 3 段重申中心＋呼吁

结尾段重申'持续学习不可或缺'的中心，并升华为一句面向未来的号召，收束全文。

第 1 段照抄首句并表态

第一句逐字写出 Nowadays more and more people keep learning new skills to adapt to a fast-changing world.；第二句点明立场：这一趋势不是一时跟风，而是对我们所处时代明智且必要的回应。

承接首句表态 · This trend, in my view, is not ___ but ___.（⽤'不是A⽽是B'把照抄来的现象句转成你的⽴场句）

亮明判断 · In my view, ___ is not merely a matter of ___ but a necessary response to ___.（在空位填本题的 '时代变化 '内容）

第 2 段技术更新＋表姐例子

先给理由：技术更新太快，多年前够用的技能可能一夜过时，停止学习者有被替代之险;再举例：当会计的表姐面对公司引进的财务软件没有抱怨，而是利用晚上自学数据分析，一年后不降反升;最后小结：持续学习正是让人保持竞争力的关键，并补一句学习也丰富生活、开阔眼界。

引出核心理由 · The most obvious reason lies in ___.（⽤来把主题句的理由点出来，空位填本题的 '技术更新快 '等）

举例过渡 · Take ___ as an example.（⼀句话⾃然切⼊具体例⼦，避免 'For example'后接空泛内容）

让步转折显态度 · Instead of ___, she chose to ___, and ___.（⽤'没有做A⽽是做 B'凸显⼈物的正⾯选择与结果）

第 3 段重申必需＋号召

先重申：以终身学习跟上变化的世界已不再是选择而是必需;再升华：与其惧怕变化，不如把每一项新技能当作通往更广阔未来的桥梁;结尾一句号召：今天拥抱新技能者，明天必能站稳脚跟。

总结收束 · In conclusion, ___ is no longer optional but essential.（⽤ '不再是可选⽽是必需 '收紧论点）

呼吁升华 · I firmly believe that whoever ___ today will ___ tomorrow.（⽤ '今天 … 者，明天必 …'把结论推向未来，⼒度更强）

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题紧扣学习主题

达标关键是：首句原样出现、立场清晰、例子直接服务于'为何要持续学习';最易失分处是例子讲了半天却与'适应快速变化的世界'无关，变成为举例而举例。

结构连贯逻辑词显化关系

本题达标要点是三段式清楚、每段一个中心;易失分处是主体段一口气堆两三个例子却不分层，或结尾又展开新论点导致收不住。

语言准确善用高频地道表达

本题可用 adapt to、keep pace with、lifelong learning、competitive 等高频地道搭配提分;易失分处是把中文逐字直译（如把'适应'写成 suit the world），或时态在同一段内忽今忽昔。

字数格式卡在规定区间内

本题硬性要求 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，低于下限或超出上限都会扣分;格式上无需称呼落款，但首句必须逐字照抄，这两点是本题最该盯住的红线。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

改写首句失硬分

反面示例（把首句改写了）：Today, an increasing number of people are learning new skills to keep up with our changing society. —— 意思虽近，但不是原句，判为未照抄。改法：第一句原样写 Nowadays more and more people keep learning new skills to adapt to a fast-changing world.， 之后再用自己的话展开。

空洞无例难服人

反面示例（泛泛而谈）：Learning new skills is very important and useful for everyone, so we should all keep learning to become better people in society. —— 全是空话没有支撑。改法：换成一个具体例子，如上文表姐自学数据分析后不降反升，用事实证明'持续学习保住并提升了竞争力'。

套话凑字挤论证

反面示例（套话开头凑字）：With the rapid development of society and economy, as we all know, everything is changing every day and nothing stays the same forever. —— 绕一大圈没进入主题。 改法：直接照抄首句进入正题，把省下的词用来把表姐的例子讲得更具体。

items.title: 2022年6月六级第3套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “Nowadays more and more people take delight in offering help to the needy.” You can make comments, cite examples, or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
Nowadays more and more people take delight in offering help to the needy. This heart-warming trend, in my view, reflects both a growing sense of social responsibility and the genuine happiness that giving brings to the giver.

There are solid reasons behind this phenomenon. On the one hand, lending a hand to those in difficulty strengthens the bonds that hold a community together, and a single act of kindness often inspires others to follow. On the other hand, helping people is deeply rewarding in itself. I still remember one winter when my classmates and I spent a weekend teaching migrant children in a shabby rented room. We gained far more warmth from their bright smiles than we ever gave, and that experience convinced me that generosity enriches both sides.

Therefore, we should never underestimate the power of a helping hand. If each of us is willing to reach out to those in need, our society will surely grow kinder, warmer and more united.

There are solid reasons behind this phenomenon. On the other hand, helping people is deeply rewarding in itself. I still remember one winter when my classmates and I spent a weekend teaching migrant children in a shabby rented room. We gained far more warmth from their bright smiles than we ever gave, and that experience convinced me that generosity enriches both sides.
Therefore, we should never underestimate the power of a helping hand. If each of us is willing to reach out to those in need, our society will surely grow kinder, warmer and more united.

items.referenceExplanation:
如今，越来越多的人乐于向有需要的人伸出援手。在我看来，这一暖心的趋势既体现了日益增强的社会责任感，也源于给予本身带给施助者的真正快乐。

这一现象背后有充分的理由。一方面，向身处困境的人伸出援手能加强维系社区的纽带，而一次善举往往会激励更多人效仿。另一方面，帮助他人本身就令人深感充实。我仍记得有一个冬天，我和同学们花了一个周末，在一间简陋的出租屋里给农民工子女补课。我们从他们灿烂的笑容中收获的温暖，远比我们付出的要多，那次经历让我确信慷慨是双向受益的。

因此，我们绝不应低估一次援手的力量。如果我们每个人都愿意向有需要的人伸出手，我们的社会必将变得更善良、更温暖、更团结。

【第 1 段】抄首句+表态定调。本段落实'抄首句再亮态度'：开头原样照抄给定首句 Nowadays more and more people take delight in offering help to the needy.，紧接用 This heart-warming trend, in my view, reflects both... 一句亮出态度并预告下文两条理由，既守住首句硬约束，又给全文定了正面基调。

【第 2 段】四步论证不空洞。本段落实'观点加理由加例子加小结'：先 There are solid reasons 总起， 再 On the one hand / On the other hand 摆社会与个人两条理由，第二条落到 one winter when my classmates and I... 的亲身经历上，最后 that experience convinced me that generosity enriches both sides 小结回扣，理由有例子撑、不空喊。

【第 3 段】回扣+呼吁升华。本段落实'回扣主旨并呼吁'：Therefore, we should never underestimate the power of a helping hand 回扣中心，If each of us is willing to reach out..., our society will surely grow kinder, warmer and more united 用条件式呼吁升华，呼应首段态度收尾，不引入新论据。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

就乐于助人现象写议论文

题面要求写 an essay that begins with the sentence，即一篇以给定首句开头的议论文；You can make comments, cite examples, or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. 进一步说明可用评论、举例或亲身经历三种方式展开。核心任务一句话钉死：就'越来越多人乐于助人'这一现象谈看法、给理由，写成一篇有观点的议论短文。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

题面只要求 write an essay，没有指定收信人或身份，说明这是纯议论大作文，不是应用文。因此用面向阅卷人的正式书面英语即可，不需要称呼、落款，也不要出现口语缩略（like gonna、wanna）和随意口气，句子要完整、有书面逻辑连接。这是六级大作文的默认语域， 判断准了就不会在语气上失分。

中心立意

助人利人也利己

中心论点：乐于助人之风盛行是一件好事——它既增强了社会的凝聚力，也让施助者本人收获真正的快乐，可谓利人也利己。这个立场明确、能站住，且天然分成两条可展开的理由。

要展开的要点

1. 助人增强社会凝聚力

第一条理由从'社会'角度切：向有困难的人伸手能拉近人与人的距离，一次善举常会带动更多人效仿，让整个社区更团结。这一点适合用一句道理加一个概括性说明来撑。

2. 助人让施助者更快乐第二条理由从'个人'角度切，正好对接题面允许的 use your personal experiences：用一次亲身经历（如周末去教农民工子女）说明帮助别人时自己收获的温暖更多，证明慷慨是双向受益的。个人经历让论证具体、不空洞。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段点现象并表态

第一段：逐字抄写给定首句引出'乐于助人增多'这一现象，随后用一句话亮明自己的态度 （这是好事），为全文定调。

第 2 段双理由加个人经历论证

第二段（主体）：从社会与个人两个角度给出两条理由，并嵌入一段亲身经历作例证， 具体论证'为什么乐于助人是好事'。

第 3 段呼吁升华收束

第三段：回扣中心，强调助人的力量，并发出'人人伸手、社会更温暖'的呼吁，把论点升华收尾。

第 1 段首句加'反映责任与快乐'

本段内容：原样抄写 take delight in offering help to the needy 所在的首句，然后表态——这一暖心趋势既体现社会责任感的增强，也源于给予本身带给施助者的快乐，为下文两条理由埋线。

照抄开篇 · 开头第⼀句直接把题⽬给定⾸句原样搬上，⼀字不改： Nowadays more and more people take delight in offering help to the needy.

亮明态度 · 紧跟表态句架： This ___ trend, in my view, reflects both ___ and ___. （填现象性质与两条理由）

第 2 段社会凝聚力+个人经历

本段内容：第一条理由讲助人增强社会凝聚力、一次善举带动他人；第二条理由讲助人本身令人快乐，并用一段周末去教农民工子女的亲身经历——从孩子们的笑容里收获的温暖比付出的更多——落实 cite examples, or use your personal experiences，最后小结'慷慨是双向受益'。

总起主题句 · 段⾸⼀句⽴观点： There are solid reasons behind this ___.（点出本段要给理由）

并列摆理由 · 两条理由⽤并列句架： On the one hand, ___; on the other hand, ___. （前社会⻆度、后个⼈⻆度）

引出个人经历 · ⽤叙事句架⾃然带出例⼦： I still remember one ___ when ___.（填时间与做的助⼈之事）

小结回扣 · 段末⼀句收束回中⼼： That experience convinced me that ___.（填从例⼦ 提炼的道理）

第 3 段呼吁人人伸手社会更暖

本段内容：强调不应低估一次援手的力量，呼吁每个人都向有需要的人伸出手，这样社会会变得更善良、更温暖、更团结，呼应首段确立的正面态度收尾。

总结升华 · 回扣句架： Therefore, we should never underestimate the power of ___. （填本⽂主题事物）

条件呼吁 · 升华呼吁句架： If each of us is willing to ___, our society will surely ___. （前填⾏动、后填愿景）

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题紧扣乐于助人且表态

本题达标点：首句抄准且全文紧扣'乐于助人'展开，有明确态度并给出理由；最易失分是只描述'大家都在帮忙'却不表态、不解释为什么，写成现象复述。

结构连贯三段清晰衔接词到位

本题达标点：三段各司其职，用 On the one hand / On the other hand / Therefore 等衔接词标出层次；易失分是通篇一段到底或理由堆在一起没有过渡，读起来像流水账。

语言准确主题词同义替换

本题达标点：把'助人'轮换成 offer help / lend a hand / reach out / help people， 把'有需要的人'轮换成 the needy / those in difficulty / those in need，体现六级要求的用词多样；易失分是全篇 help the needy 反复出现，显得单调。

字数格式卡在150到200之间

本题硬约束是 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，低于下限或超过上限都按规则扣分，因此要把篇幅控制在区间内，宁可主体段展开充分也别为凑字反复注水。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

改写首句致离题

反面示例：把开头写成 These days, people are more and more willing to help poor people.（把给定首句改写了）。这违反 begins with the sentence 的硬性要求，开篇即失分。修正：老老实实照抄——Nowadays more and more people take delight in offering help to the needy.

口号堆砌无例证

反面示例：Helping others is good. It is very important. Everyone should help others because it is meaningful and helpful.（三句都是空口号、无内容）。修正：换成有细节的经历——I still remember one winter when my classmates and I spent a weekend teaching migrant children, and their smiles warmed us more than we had expected.

有态度无理由

反面示例：Nowadays more and more people take delight in offering help to the needy. I think this is a very good thing. So we should do it.（表了态却没给任何理由）。修正：补上社会与个人两条理由并各自展开，如助人增强凝聚力、助人让自己更快乐。

同义重复凑字数

反面示例：Helping the needy is good. Helping the needy is really good. Helping the poor people is very very good.（同一句反复注水）。修正：把这段替换成对某条理由的实质展开，例如说明一次善举如何 inspire others to follow，让字数由内容自然增长。

items.title: 2022年9月六级第1套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “Nowadays more and more students are becoming increasingly aware of the importance of developing digital skills.” You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
Nowadays more and more students are becoming increasingly aware of the importance of developing digital skills. This awareness is well founded, for in an age reshaped by technology, the ability to handle digital tools has become as basic as reading and writing.

There are solid reasons behind this trend. For one thing, digital competence directly boosts academic efficiency. In my own case, learning to use spreadsheets and reference software turned a painful week of manual data sorting into an afternoon's work. Moreover, such skills open doors in the job market. For instance, a classmate who taught herself basic programming stood out among hundreds of applicants and landed an internship at a tech firm. As a result, students who master these tools gain a clear edge both in study and in career.

In conclusion, the growing attention to digital skills reflects a genuine need rather than a passing fashion. Students would be wise to invest time in mastering practical tools instead of waiting until graduation, so that they can thrive in a world that runs on technology.

items.referenceExplanation:
如今越来越多的学生日益意识到培养数字技能的重要性。这种意识是有充分依据的，因为在一个被技术重塑的时代，操作数字工具的能力已经像读写一样成为一项基本能力。

这一趋势背后有实在的原因。一方面，数字能力直接提升学业效率。就我自己而言，学会使用表格软件和文献管理软件，把原本要手动整理一周的数据变成了一个下午就能完成的工作。此外，这类技能还能打开

就业的大门。比如，我的一位同学自学了基础编程，在数百名申请者中脱颖而出，拿到了一家科技公司的实习。因此，掌握这些工具的学生在学习和职业上都获得了明显的优势。

总之，人们对数字技能日益增长的关注反映的是一种真实的需要，而非一时的风尚。学生们明智的做法是趁早投入时间去掌握实用工具，而不是等到毕业，这样他们才能在一个依靠技术运转的世界里立足。

【第 1 段】抄首句后一句定调。首句逐字照抄题目要求（This awareness is well founded 之前的那句），守住硬约束；紧接的 This awareness is well founded, for ... has become as basic as reading and writing 用『承接首句表态』与『打比方强化』两个句架，把别人的重视变成本文要论证的立场，开头不再是孤句。

【第 2 段】两理由各坐实一例。There are solid reasons... For one thing 总起并领起理由一，In my own case 用个人经历坐实效率提升；Moreover 递进出理由二，For instance 用同学自学编程的人物例子坐实就业优势；末句 As a result 因果收束。四个句架各司其职，论证落地不空喊。

【第 3 段】重申＋建议闭环。In conclusion... reflects a genuine need rather than a passing fashion 重申立场、回扣首句；Students would be wise to... instead of... so that... 给出尽早投入的具体建议， 全文首尾呼应收口。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

首句续写议论文

本题要求写 an essay that begins with the sentence 指定首句的短文，且明确 begins with the sentence 的首句已把话题和立场都定死——即『学生越来越意识到培养数字技能的重要性』。 所以你的任务不是重新提出观点，而是接着这句已给的立场，论证数字技能为何日益重要、如何培养。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

本题没有指定收信人，是一篇公开发表式的议论文，题目允许你 make comments、cite examples 或用亲身经历来展开，都是对着读者摆事实讲道理。因此用面向阅卷人的正式书面语即可，不需要称呼、不需要署名，避免口语缩写和随意的网络用词。

中心立意

数字技能确实值得学生投入

承接首句既定立场，本篇中心是：学生对数字技能的重视是有真实依据的，它同时提升学业效率和就业竞争力，因此值得尽早投入学习，而非临近毕业才补。这一立场与首句 Nowadays more and more students are becoming increasingly aware of the importance of developing digital skills. 完全咬合，不另起炉灶。

要展开的要点

1. 理由一：提升学业效率

数字技能直接提高学习效率——用表格软件、文献检索工具处理原本要手动完成的作业，可以省下大量时间。这一条对应题目允许的 use your personal experiences，可用亲身经历落地。

2. 理由二：增强就业竞争掌握编程、数据处理等技能能在求职市场上脱颖而出。这一条用 cite examples 举一个具体的人物例子来支撑，而不是空喊『对找工作有用』。

3. 收束：建议尽早投入

结尾呼应首句的重视立场，给出一句建议——尽早动手掌握实用工具，而不是等到毕业，让全文在同一立场上收口。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段照抄首句＋定调

逐字照抄题目指定首句作为开篇，再补一句点明这一重视是有依据的，把全文立场立稳。

第 2 段理由＋例子论证

主体段，用两条理由（提升学业效率、增强就业竞争）加个人经历与具体人物例子，论证数字技能为何重要。

第 3 段重申立场＋建议收尾

重申数字技能是真实需要而非一时风气，给出尽早投入的建议，呼应首句收口。

第 1 段抄首句＋点明有依据

照抄 Nowadays more and more students are becoming increasingly aware of the importance of developing digital skills.，随后补一句：这种重视是有依据的，因为在技术重塑的时代，操作数字工具已像读写一样成为基本能力。

承接首句表态 · This awareness is well founded, for ___.

打比方强化 · ___ has become as basic as ___.

第 2 段两理由各配一例

理由一提升效率，配个人经历（学会表格与文献软件，把手动整理一周的活变成一下午）； 理由二增强就业，配人物例子（同学自学编程从众多申请者中脱颖而出拿到实习），最后一句点出掌握工具者在学习与职业上都有明显优势。

总起引出理由 · There are solid reasons behind this trend. For one thing, ___.

举例过渡 · For instance, ___. / In my own case, ___.

递进加理由 · Moreover, ___.

因果收束 · As a result, ___.

第 3 段真实需要＋尽早投入

重申对数字技能的关注反映的是真实需要而非一时风气，建议学生趁早花时间掌握实用工具，而非等到毕业，以便在依赖技术运转的世界里立足。

重申立场 · In conclusion, ___ reflects a genuine need rather than ___.

给出建议 · Students would be wise to ___ instead of ___, so that ___.

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题全程扣住数字技能重要性

本题最易跑题处是首句之后另起炉灶谈别的。要保证每段都围绕『数字技能为何重要、如何培养』，并善用题目给的 make comments、cite examples、use your personal experiences 中的方式展开，不空谈无关话题。

结构连贯三段首尾呼应

本题用『首句立论—理由加例证—重申建议』三段，段内靠 For one thing／ Moreover／As a result 串起因果，结尾一句回扣首句立场，做到首尾呼应而非各段孤立。

语言准确少而稳的高级表达

本题可用 well founded、boost efficiency、stand out among、gain an edge 等准确搭配替换 very important 这类平淡词，但要确保拼写和用法无误，宁可稳妥也不堆砌没把握的大词。

字数格式守住区间与照抄首句

本题硬约束是 You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. 且开头须 begins with the sentence 指定的那句。二者任缺其一都直接失分，写完务必逐字回查首句、再核字数。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

改写首句

反面示例把首句改成 Today, students realize digital skills matter a lot.（改写＝违规）。修正：开头必须原样写 Nowadays more and more students are becoming increasingly aware of the importance of developing digital skills.

通篇喊口号

反面示例：Digital skills are very important. They are useful. Everyone should learn them.（三句都是空判断）。修正：换成具体经历，如 In my own case, learning spreadsheet software turned a week of manual work into an afternoon's task.

同义反复凑字

反面示例：Digital skills are important. In other words, they are of great importance. Truly, they matter greatly.（三句一个意思）。修正：删掉重复，改为补充新信息，如 Beyond study, these skills also open doors in the job market.

逐字直译

反面示例：Learn digital skills can let students' study become more effective.（let 主语误用、动名词缺失）。修正：Learning digital skills can make students' study more efficient.

items.title: 2022年9月六级第2套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “Today more and more people begin to realize the pleasures and joys of real-world social interaction.” You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay.You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
Today more and more people begin to realize the pleasures and joys of real-world social interaction. After years of staring at glowing screens, many of us have discovered that a warm handshake, a shared laugh or a face-to-face chat brings a satisfaction that no online message can replace.

My own experience convinces me of this. Last summer I put down my phone and joined a hiking club in my hometown. Instead of typing emojis, I talked, sweated and cooked with real people on the trail. When a stranger offered me water on a steep slope, I felt a genuine bond that no number of online 'likes' had ever given me. Those weekends left me happier and more energetic than a whole year of scrolling ever did.

Therefore, real-world social interaction feeds a need that technology alone cannot satisfy. It reminds us that we are living beings who thrive on presence, eye contact and shared moments. Let us step out of the virtual world more often and reconnect with the people around us, for it is there that true joy quietly grows.

items.referenceExplanation:
如今越来越多的人开始体会到现实世界面对面社交的乐趣与快乐。在长年盯着发光屏幕之后，我们许多人发现，一次热情的握手、一阵共同的欢笑或一场面对面的交谈，所带来的满足是任何线上信息都无法替代的。

我自己的经历让我对此深信不疑。去年夏天，我放下手机，加入了家乡的一个徒步俱乐部。我不再敲打表情包，而是在山路上与真实的人交谈、流汗、一起做饭。当一个陌生人在陡坡上递给我水时，我感到一种真诚的联结，那是再多的线上'点赞'都不曾给过我的。那些周末让我比刷了一整年手机还要快乐、有活力。

因此，现实世界的社交满足了技术本身无法满足的需求。它提醒我们，人本是依靠在场、眼神交流与共同时刻而生活的生命。让我们更常走出虚拟世界，与身边的人重新连接吧，因为真正的快乐正是在那里悄悄生长。

【第 1 段】首句照抄＋一句点题。开头逐字照抄了给定首句，紧接着用 After years of staring at glowing screens... 一句完成线上线下的对比并点出中心，落实了 outline 第一段'照抄＋亮中心'的功能。

【第 2 段】一个例子把抽象观点写实。用徒步俱乐部的经历（talked, sweated and cooked、陌生人递水）把'乐趣'写成可感的场景，末句 happier and more energetic 回扣中心，兑现了'举经历论证'。

【第 3 段】重申＋升华＋呼吁。Therefore... 一句回扣中心，living beings who thrive on presence 升华到人性，末句 Let us... 发出呼吁收尾，避免了烂尾。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

写现实社交之乐

本题是首句续写议论文，write an essay that begins with the sentence 之后钉死的主题就是 real-world social interaction 的 the pleasures and joys，即现实世界面对面交往带来的乐趣。 全文任务就是围绕这一点展开、把它写得可信。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

本题无具体收信人，属纯议论大作文，面向阅卷人用正式、客观、有条理的书面语即可；无需称呼、无需署名，避免口语化缩写和网络用语堆砌。

中心立意

现实社交带来线上无可替代的快乐

全文中心立场：面对面的现实社交能带来 the pleasures and joys，这种满足感是虚拟社交无法替代的，值得我们主动走出屏幕去经营。

要展开的要点

1. 点题：现实社交之乐正被重新发现

承接首句，说明为何越来越多人重视 real-world social interaction——正因为屏幕社交久了，人们反而发现真实相处的温度。

2. 个人经历佐证乐趣题目明确允许 make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay，用一次具体的现实社交经历（如加入徒步俱乐部）把抽象的'乐趣'写实。

3. 升华：现实交往满足人的天性

总结现实社交满足了技术无法满足的情感需求，呼吁走出虚拟世界与人重连，收束全文。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段首句照抄＋点题亮中心

逐字照抄给定首句作为开头，随即用一两句点明现实社交为何被重新珍视，亮出全文中心。

第 2 段举亲身经历论证

用一次具体的现实社交经历，展开证明现实交往带来线上无法替代的快乐。

第 3 段重申中心＋升华呼吁

回扣中心，指出现实社交满足人的天性，以一句呼吁收尾。

第 1 段屏幕看久了，人们重新发现真实相处的温度

落点：照抄 Today more and more people begin to realize the pleasures and joys of real-world social interaction 之后，说明长期盯屏幕后人们发现面对面的握手、欢笑带来线上信息无法替代的满足。

承接首句亮观点 · After years of ___, many of us have discovered that ___ brings a satisfaction that ___ cannot replace.

并列具体意象铺垫 · A ___, a ___ or a ___ — these small moments ___.

第 2 段徒步俱乐部里的真实相处

落点：题目允许 use your personal experiences to develop your essay，写去年放下手机加入徒步俱乐部，与真人一起交谈、流汗、做饭，陌生人递水带来'点赞'给不了的联结。

引入个人经历 · My own experience convinces me of this. Last ___, I ___.

对比虚实收束 · When ___, I felt a genuine ___ that no ___ had ever given me.

第 3 段现实交往满足技术无法满足的天性

落点：现实社交满足了技术无法满足的情感需求，人本是靠在场、眼神、共处而生的，呼吁多走出虚拟世界与身边人重连。

因果重申中心 · Therefore, ___ feeds a need that ___ alone cannot satisfy.

祈使呼吁收尾 · Let us ___ more often and ___, for it is there that ___.

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题紧扣现实社交的正面乐趣

本题核心是 real-world social interaction 带来的 the pleasures and joys，切忌跑去写网络危害或手机成瘾，要正面写现实交往的好。

结构连贯三段各司其职、连接词清晰

首句点题—经历论证—升华呼吁三段分明，段首用 My own experience.../Therefore... 明示逻辑，避免想到哪写到哪。

语言准确经历段过去时统一、用词具体

写去年经历用 put/joined/talked 等过去式，动词具体（sweated, cooked）胜过空泛的 was very happy。

字数格式落在规定区间、无需称呼署名

本题要求 You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，属议论文无需称呼与署名，重点是既别低于下限也别超上限。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

把首句改写成自己的话

反面示例：'Nowadays, people are enjoying real-life communication more and more.' —— 这是改写而非照抄，首段失分。正确做法是逐字照抄 Today more and more people begin to realize the pleasures and joys of real-world social interaction. 之后再展开。

只议论不举例

反面示例：'Real-world interaction is good. It makes us happy. We should do it more.' —— 全是断言、无支撑。改法：补上一段具体经历，如加入徒步俱乐部、陌生人递水的细节，让'快乐'看得见。

跑题写手机危害

反面示例：整段大谈 'Smartphones ruin our eyes and waste our time.' 这偏离核心。改法：把重心放回现实交往的乐趣，线上仅一句带过作对比。

items.title: 2022年9月六级第3套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sen tence “It is now widely accepted that mutual trust and openness is the key to promoting cooperation.” You can make comments,cite examples, or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
items.referenceEssay:
It is now widely accepted that mutual trust and openness is the key to promoting cooperation. When people or organizations are willing to share information honestly and believe in each other's good intentions, they can join hands far more effectively than those who hold everything back.

The reason is simple: trust removes the fear that keeps partners guarding themselves, while openness lets them pool their strengths toward a common goal. A telling example is my own experience in a group research project last term. At first, two members kept their data private, worried that others might take the credit, and our progress almost stalled. Once we agreed to be transparent and openly admitted our doubts, ideas flowed freely, tasks were divided fairly, and we finished ahead of schedule. The same logic explains why companies that communicate frankly with their partners tend to build lasting alliances rather than short-lived deals.

In short, without trust and openness, cooperation is built on sand. Only when we dare to be honest and give others our confidence can genuine collaboration take root and bear fruit.

outline.content: It is now widely accepted that mutual trust and openness is the key to promoting cooperation. When people or organizations are willing to share information honestly and believe in each other's good intentions, they can join hands far more effectively than those who hold everything back.

The reason is simple: trust removes the fear that keeps partners guarding themselves, while openness lets them pool their strengths toward a common goal. A telling example is my own experience in a group research project last term. At first, two members kept their data private, worried that others might take the credit, and our progress almost stalled. Once we agreed to be transparent and openly admitted our doubts, ideas flowed freely, tasks were divided fairly, and we finished ahead of schedule. The same logic explains why companies that communicate frankly with their partners tend to build lasting alliances rather than short-lived deals.
In short, without trust and openness, cooperation is built on sand. Only when we dare to be honest and give others our confidence can genuine collaboration take root and bear fruit.

items.referenceExplanation:
如今人们普遍认为，相互信任与开放是促进合作的关键。当人们或组织愿意坦诚地共享信息、相信彼此心怀善意时，他们携手共事的效率，会远远高于那些把一切都藏着掖着的人。

道理很简单：信任消除了让伙伴彼此设防的顾虑，而开放让双方得以把各自的长处汇聚到共同目标上。一个很能说明问题的例子来自我上学期一次小组研究项目的亲身经历。起初，两名成员把自己的数据藏着不肯共享，担心别人抢功，我们的进度几乎停滞。一旦我们约定彼此透明、坦率地说出各自的疑虑，想法便

自由流动，任务分工公平，我们最终提前完成了任务。同样的逻辑也解释了为什么那些与合作方坦诚沟通的企业，往往能结成长久的联盟，而非昙花一现的交易。

总之，没有信任与开放，合作就像建在沙上。只有当我们敢于坦诚、愿意把信任交给他人时，真正的协作才能扎根、结果。

【第 1 段】首句照抄加方向句。本段第一句原样照抄了题目首句，第二句 When people or organizations are willing to share information honestly... 用一个鲜明对比点明方向，落实了‘抄首句后一句点方向’。

【第 2 段】道理加亲历加回扣三步。本段先用 The reason is simple: trust removes the fear... 讲清因果机制，再用 my own experience in a group research project 举亲历例子，最后 The same logic explains why companies... 把逻辑延伸并回扣中心，正是‘先讲道理再落一例’。

【第 3 段】反面加正面重申。本段先用 without trust and openness, cooperation is built on sand 从反面强调分量，再用 Only when we dare to be honest... 正面重申升华，落实‘反面收紧再正面重申’。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

论证信任开放是合作关键

本题要求写一篇以指定句开头的议论短文，全文论证 It is now widely accepted that mutual trust and openness is the key to promoting cooperation. 这一判断，并可 make comments,cite examples, or use your personal experiences 来展开。核心任务就一句：说清‘相互信任与开放为什么是促进合作的关键’。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式议论文

题目只说 write an essay that begins with 指定首句，没有设定收信人或身份，因此这是一篇面向阅卷人的正式书面议论文：用完整句、正规词汇，不用缩写、口语和聊天式第二人称，观点鲜明即可，不必套用书信格式。

中心立意

信任开放促成高效合作

中心论点直接沿用首句 mutual trust and openness is the key to promoting cooperation：只有彼此信任、坦诚开放，合作才能真正高效；否则各自设防，合作必然低效甚至瓦解。

要展开的要点

1. 机制：除防备、促共享

第一要点讲因果机制——信任消除‘怕被占便宜’的防备心，开放让双方把各自的信息和长处汇到一起，对应题目允许的 make comments 评议角度。

2. 例证：亲历加企业层面第二要点用事例证明——一段小组项目的亲身经历（藏数据几乎停滞，坦诚后超额完成），再延伸到坦诚沟通的企业更易结成长期联盟，对应 cite examples, or use your personal experiences。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段抄首句加亮方向

第一段：逐字照抄首句 It is now widely accepted that mutual trust and openness is the key to promoting cooperation.，再补一句点明全文方向。

第 2 段论证机制加例证

第二段：先讲信任开放促成合作的因果机制，再用一个亲历或企业例子证明并回扣中心。

第 3 段重申观点收尾

第三段：从反面强调其重要性，再正面重申观点、升华收束。

第 1 段照抄首句加点明方向

本段开头逐字照抄 It is now widely accepted that mutual trust and openness is the key to promoting cooperation.，随后补一句：愿意诚实共享信息、相信彼此善意的人，比处处设防的人合作得高效得多，为下文定调。

承接首句 · When ____ are willing to ____, they can ____ far more effectively than those who ____.（填：主体 / 信任开放的⾏为 / ⽬标动作 / 反⾯做法）

亮明立场 · In my view, ____ is exactly what turns strangers into partners.（填：本⽂ 要论证的关键因素）

第 2 段机制句加小组亲历加企业延伸

先写机制：信任除去防备、开放让双方汇聚长处；再讲小组研究项目的亲历——起初有人藏数据几乎停滞，转为透明坦诚后按时超额完成；最后延伸到坦诚沟通的企业更易结成长期联盟，正对应题目 make comments,cite examples, or use your personal experiences 允许的展开方式。

引出机制 · The reason is simple: ____ removes ____, while ____ lets ____.（填： 信任 / 防备顾虑 / 开放 / 双⽅共享什么）

举例过渡 · A telling example is ____, where at first ____, and only after ____ did ____.（填：例⼦对象 / 初始困境 / 转变动作 / 好结果）

回扣中心 · The same logic explains why ____ tend to ____ rather than ____.（填： 延伸对象 / 正⾯结果 / 反⾯结果）

第 3 段反面强调加正面升华

先从反面强调：没有信任与开放，合作就像建在沙上；再正面重申：只有敢于诚实、给予他人信任，真正的协作才能扎根结果。

反面强调 · In short, without ____, ____ is built on sand.（填：关键因素 / 合作）

结论升华 · Only when we dare to ____ can ____ take root and bear fruit.（填：诚实或信任的动作 / 真正的合作）

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题紧扣信任开放促合作

本题所有内容必须围绕 It is now widely accepted that mutual trust and openness is the key to promoting cooperation.，例子须回到‘信任开放’与‘合作’的因果上，别写成泛泛的团队合作好处。

结构连贯三段衔接自然

首段到论证段要有过渡，本范文用 The reason is simple、A telling example、In short 串起因果、举例、收束，确保从首句到论证一路顺下来。

语言准确亲历用过去时并避免直译

讲小组经历要用过去时（kept、finished），别用中式直译如 people no trust；用 remove the fear、pool their strengths 这类地道搭配更稳。

字数格式对照上下限自查

对照写作要求给定的字数上限与下限，写完数一遍，既不能不足也不能超；三段式、 段落清晰即符合格式，不必套用书信格式。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

改写了首句

反面示例：把开头写成 Nowadays many people believe trust and openness are important for cooperation. 这就违反了 write an essay that begins with 指定句的要求；正确做法是开头原样照抄 It is now widely accepted that mutual trust and openness is the key to promoting cooperation.。

只喊口号不展开

反面示例：Trust is very important. Openness is also important. Cooperation needs them very much. 三句都在重复却没展开；改法是补出因果机制并 cite examples, or use your personal experiences，比如加一段小组项目的亲历。

例子不回扣

反面示例：详细讲了小组怎么分工、怎么熬夜赶工，却没说这和信任开放有什么关系；改法是在例子末尾补一句 Only after we chose to trust each other and share openly did we succeed. 把例子扣回中心。

逐字直译成病句

反面示例：If people no trust, cooperate will fail. 是逐字直译的病句；改成 Without mutual trust, cooperation is bound to fail. 既准确又地道。

items.title: 2023年12月六级第1套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence "As is known to all, gaining a sound knowledge of the basics is of vital importance for students to master an academic subject.”You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words (not including the sentence given).
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
As is known to all, gaining a sound knowledge of the basics is of vital importance for students to master an academic subject. Just as a towering building cannot stand firm without a solid foundation, no student can reach academic heights unless the fundamentals are first laid down. The basics are not the trivial part of learning; they are the very ground on which deeper understanding is built.

In my own experience, this truth was made vivid when I began studying programming. At first I was eager to write fancy applications and skipped the elementary concepts of variables and loops. As a result, whenever a bug appeared, I had no idea where to look, and my code collapsed completely. It was only after I went back and mastered these basics that I could finally trace errors and write reliable programs. This lesson taught me that shortcuts around the fundamentals lead nowhere.

It follows that students should never underestimate the value of the basics. Rather than rushing toward complicated tasks, we ought to devote patient effort to consolidating the fundamentals first. Only by standing on such firm ground can we climb steadily toward true mastery of any subject.

items.referenceExplanation:
众所周知，扎实掌握基础知识对于学生掌握一门学科至关重要。正如高楼没有坚实的地基就无法屹立，学生若不先打牢基础，也无法登上学术的高峰。基础绝非学习中无关紧要的部分，它正是更深层理解赖以建立的根基。

以我自己的经历为例，当我开始学习编程时，这个道理变得格外真切。起初我急于写出花哨的程序，跳过了变量、循环这些最基本的概念。结果一旦出现程序错误，我便毫无头绪，代码彻底崩溃。直到我回过头去真正掌握了这些基础，我才终于能够排查错误、写出可靠的程序。这段教训告诉我：绕过基础的捷径， 最终无路可走。

由此可见，学生绝不应低估基础的价值。与其急着去攻克复杂的任务，我们更应付出耐心去先巩固基础。 唯有立足于如此坚实的根基，我们才能稳步攀登，走向对任何学科的真正掌握。

【第 1 段】首句照抄＋比喻点题。开头一字不差照抄了给定首句，随后用 "Just as a towering building cannot stand firm without a solid foundation" 的比喻和 "The basics are not the trivial part of learning; they are the very ground" 的对比句把中心说透，落实了第一段『照抄首句再比喻点题』的方法。

【第 2 段】经历举证有细节。用 "In my own experience" 引入亲身经历，按『起初 skipped the elementary concepts → 结果 my code collapsed → 后来 mastered these basics』的时间线讲具体， 末句 "This lesson taught me that shortcuts around the fundamentals lead nowhere" 回扣中心，兑现了『以经历举证展开』的方法，避免空喊。

【第 3 段】推论收束＋给建议。用 "It follows that" 自然导出结论，"Rather than rushing toward complicated tasks, we ought to" 给出可操作建议，末句 "Only by standing on such firm ground can we" 用倒装升华收尾，落实了第三段『推论收束加建议』的方法。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

续写议论文论证首句观点

本题要求 write an essay that begins with the sentence 给定的那句话，也就是先把首句原样搬上去，再自己写正文去论证它。展开方式题目已明说：make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay——评论、举例、个人经历三选一即可，不必全用。一句话钉死任务：围绕『打牢基础对掌握一门学科至关重要』写一篇有例证的议论文。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

这是纯议论大作文，没有具体收信人，也不需要称呼和落款。读者就是阅卷老师，语域用正式书面英语即可：不用缩写口语（don't、gonna），多用完整句和书面连接词。六级作文这一档只要不写成聊天口吻、不出现网络用语，语域就稳了。

中心立意

基础是掌握学科的根基

中心论点直接由首句定死，无需另立：gaining a sound knowledge of the basics is of vital importance for students to master an academic subject。全文只做一件事——反复用道理和事例证明这句话，绝不能中途拐去写『如何学好英语』『努力的重要性』等别的话题。

要展开的要点

1. 基础是深入学习的地基

用打比方讲道理：高楼离不开地基，学科的深层理解也离不开扎实的基础。这一点为首句提供 『为什么重要』的说理支撑，放在第一段收尾。

2. 跳过基础必付代价（个人经历） 用一段真实感的个人经历举证：学编程时急着写花哨程序、跳过变量和循环等基本概念，结果一出 bug 就束手无策，回头补牢基础后才走通。这一点把抽象道理落到具体故事，是全文的论证主干。

3. 沉心巩固基础再进阶（对策）

从前两点自然推出建议：不要急于求成，应先耐心夯实基础再往上走。这一点收束全文、把论证升华为可操作的态度，放在结尾段。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段照抄首句＋点明中心

原样搬入给定首句，再用一个比喻和一句判断把『基础是根基』这一中心说透，为下文论证定调。

第 2 段个人经历举证

用一段学编程的亲身经历，具体展示跳过基础的代价与补牢基础后的转机，坐实首句观点。

第 3 段推论收束＋提建议

由前文推出结论，重申基础之重要，并给出『沉心巩固基础再进阶』的建议，收尾升华。

第 1 段基础如地基，撑起学科高楼

照抄首句后，用『高楼离不开地基』类比学科学习离不开扎实基础，再断言基础是深层理解赖以建立的根基，为全文定调。

比喻立论 · Just as ＿＿ cannot ＿＿ without ＿＿, no ＿＿ can ＿＿ unless ＿＿.（把抽象观点嫁接到⼀个具体⽐喻上，避免开头空喊）

强调根基 · The ＿＿ are not ＿＿; they are the very ground on which ＿＿ is built.（⽤ 『不是 …⽽是根基』的对⽐句强化重要性）

第 2 段学编程跳过基础后吃了亏

讲述学编程时急于写花哨程序、跳过变量和循环等基本概念，一出 bug 就无从下手，直到回头补牢基础才能排错、写出可靠程序，从而印证首句。

引入个人经历 · In my own experience, this truth was made vivid when I ＿＿.（⾃然带出亲⾝经历，避免⽣硬举例）

结果过渡 · At first I ＿＿; as a result, ＿＿.（⽤『起初 …结果 …』串起因果，让故事有转折）

经历小结 · This lesson taught me that ＿＿.（把故事收回到论点上，防⽌例⼦与观点脱节）

第 3 段别急于求成，先夯实基础

由前文推出：学生不应低估基础的价值，与其急着攻复杂任务，不如先耐心巩固基础，唯有立于坚实根基才能稳步走向真正的掌握。

推论收束 · It follows that ＿＿ should never underestimate ＿＿.（⽤推论词把论证导向结论）

对比提建议 · Rather than ＿＿, we ought to ＿＿.（⽤『与其 …不如 …』给出可操作建议）

升华结尾 · Only by ＿＿ can we ＿＿.（⽤倒装强调句收尾，把观点推到⾼处）

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题全程围绕『基础重要』

本题限定主旨极窄：只谈 gaining a sound knowledge of the basics is of vital importance for students to master an academic subject，且已用个人经历（题目允许的 use your personal experiences to develop your essay）落地。最易失分处是写着写着拐去谈努力或学习方法，务必段段回扣『基础』二字。

结构连贯总分总＋过渡词到位

本范文用 In my own experience（引例）、As a result（因果）、It follows that（推论）把三段串成一条论证链，段落功能清晰。自查时确认这些路标都在，且首段中段尾段各司其职、无颠倒。

语言准确叙事过去时、说理现在时

本题第二段是过去经历，须统一用过去时（was、skipped、collapsed）；第一、三段是普遍道理，用现在时。适度点缀 Just as… 比喻句、Only by… 倒装句提分，但每用一个高级句都要确认语法无误，别为炫技而出错。

字数格式首句不计、区间硬控

本题硬约束是 You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，且明确 not including the sentence given。所以正文（不含首句）必须够 150 词，同时全文别失控超界。数字数时把首句排除在外，这是本题最易踩的坑。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

抄完首句正文只两句

反面示例：照抄首句后只写『The basics are very important. We should learn them well.』就收尾， 正文远不足下限、且空洞。改法：把『重要』落到具体经历上——先讲跳过基础出了什么问题，再讲补牢后有何改变，用细节把段落撑起来。

通篇重复『基础很重要』

反面示例：『Basics are important. Without basics, we cannot learn well. So basics are really important for students.』——三句话在原地打转。改法：换成一段有起承转合的经历（如学编程跳过基础后一出 bug 就束手无策），让论证有血有肉。

拐去大谈努力的重要

反面示例：正文大篇幅写『Hard work is the key to success, and diligent students always win.』， 把主题偷换成努力。改法：即使谈到勤奋，也要落回『把勤奋用在夯实基础上』，始终扣住 basics 这个核心词。

items.title: 2023年12月六级第2套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “Nowadays parents are increasingly aware that allowing kids more freedom to explore and learn on their own helps foster their independence and boost their confidence.” You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay.You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words(not including the sentence given).
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
Nowadays parents are increasingly aware that allowing kids more freedom to explore and learn on their own helps foster their independence and boost their confidence. This shift in parenting reflects a valuable truth: children grow strongest not when every step is arranged for them, but when they are trusted to try, fail, and try again.

To begin with, freedom teaches independence in a way no lecture ever could. A child who is allowed to plan a weekend trip, cook a simple meal, or solve a quarrel with friends gradually learns to rely on his own judgment. Take my younger cousin, for example. When his mother stopped correcting his every homework mistake and let him check the answers himself, his grades slowly improved, and, more importantly, he began tackling new problems without fear. Each small success became a brick building his confidence.

In this way, granting children the room to explore freely is not a risk but a wise investment. As a result, they mature into adults who dare to think, decide, and stand on their own feet.

A child who is allowed to plan a weekend trip, cook a simple meal, or solve a quarrel with friends gradually learns to rely on his own judgment. Take my younger cousin, for example. When his mother stopped correcting his every homework mistake and let him check the answers himself, his grades slowly improved, and, more importantly, he began tackling new problems without fear. items.referenceExplanation:
如今父母越来越意识到，给孩子更多自由去探索、自主学习，有助于培养他们的独立性、增强他们的自信。这种教养观的转变背后是一个宝贵的真理：孩子并非在每一步都被安排好时才成长得最好，而是在被信任去尝试、失败、再尝试时才最为强大。

首先，自由教会孩子的独立，是任何说教都无法给予的。一个被允许去规划周末出行、做一顿简单的饭、 或自己化解与朋友争执的孩子，会逐渐学会依靠自己的判断。以我的表弟为例。当他妈妈不再逐题纠正他

的每一处作业错误、而让他自己核对答案后，他的成绩慢慢提高了，更重要的是，他开始不再害怕去攻克新问题。每一次小小的成功，都成了垒起他自信的一块砖。

就这样，给孩子自由探索的空间，不是一种冒险，而是一项明智的投资。因此，他们会长成敢想、敢决断、能靠自己双脚站稳的大人。

【第 1 段】抄首句＋桥接点题。首句 Nowadays parents are increasingly aware... 逐字照抄，随后 This shift in parenting reflects a valuable truth: 一句用了桥接点题句架，把中心判断亮出，衔接自然、方向清晰。

【第 2 段】主题句＋亲历例证。To begin with, freedom teaches independence... 是分论点主题句； Take my younger cousin, for example. 用举例过渡句架引出亲身经历，最后 Each small success became a brick building his confidence. 把例子回扣到自信，道理与例子咬合。

【第 3 段】重申＋升华。In this way, ... is not a risk but a wise investment. 用收束句架重申中心；As a result, they mature into adults who dare to... 升华一层，落回 independence 与 confidence，不简单复读首句。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

顺着首句论证「给自由养独立」

任务是就给定首句往下写：首句已经亮明了一个正面论点——让孩子更多自由去探索、自主学习，有助于培养独立性、增强自信。你要做的是 make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay，即顺势展开论证、把这个观点讲透，而不是另立观点或去反驳它。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式议论文

本题是纯议论大作文，没有具体收信人，也 not including the sentence given 之外无署名要求，因此语域按「面向阅卷人的正式书面语」处理即可：用完整句、避免口语缩略和网络语， 保持客观说理的语气，不需要称呼语和落款。

中心立意

自由探索是成长的最佳投资

中心论点顺着首句延伸：给孩子自由去探索和自主学习，看似冒险，实则是对其独立与自信最值得的投资。全篇都为证明这一点服务，回应题目 helps foster their independence and boost their confidence 的两个落点。

要展开的要点

1. 自由锻炼独立判断第一个角度谈独立：亲身去做选择和解决问题，比任何说教都更能教会孩子依靠自己的判断， 正是 learn on their own 的价值所在。

2. 小成功累积自信

第二个角度谈自信：每一次自主完成的小任务都是一块砖，慢慢垒起孩子面对新问题时的底气，落到题目所说的 boost their confidence。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段抄首句＋过渡点题

原样照抄给定首句，再补一句过渡，把「自由是成长投资」的中心论点亮出来。

第 2 段道理＋实例论证

主体段：先讲自由锻炼独立的道理，再用一个亲身经历的例子印证，落到独立与自信的双重收获。

第 3 段回扣升华收束

结尾段：把「自由不是风险而是投资」的判断收拢，升华到孩子长成敢想敢担的大人。

第 1 段首句原样＋点明是投资

照抄 Nowadays parents are increasingly aware that allowing kids more freedom to explore and learn on their own helps foster their independence and boost their confidence，随后补一句：这种教养观转变背后是一个朴素真理——孩子不是被安排好每一步才成长，而是被信任去尝试、失败、再尝试时才最强大。

桥接点题句架 · This shift in ___ reflects a valuable truth: ___ grow strongest not when ___, but when ___.（⽤于抄完⾸句后承接并亮出中⼼判断）

第 2 段表弟自查作业变自信的亲历

主题句说自由教会的独立是任何说教都给不了的；道理句说被允许自己规划、自己解决矛盾的孩子学会依靠判断；例子用亲历：表弟的妈妈不再逐题纠错、让他自己核对答案后，成绩慢慢提高，更重要的是他开始不怕面对新问题；小结句把每次小成功比作垒起自信的砖。

分论点主题句架 · To begin with, ___ teaches ___ in a way no lecture ever could.（段⾸ 亮分论点，强调亲历胜过说教）

举例过渡句架 · Take ___, for example. When ___, ___ gradually ___.（⾃然引出⼀个具体例⼦ /亲⾝经历）

第 3 段自由是投资＋长成敢担的人

重申：给孩子探索的空间不是冒险而是明智的投资；升华：正因如此，他们才会长成敢想、 敢决定、能独立站稳的大人，呼应首句的 independence 与 confidence。

收束重申句架 · In this way, ___ is not a risk but a wise investment.（⽤衔接词收拢并重申中⼼判断）

升华递进句架 · As a result, they mature into ___ who dare to ___.（把结论推向更⻓远的⼀层，制造余味）

R E V I E W · 自检避坑

本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题紧扣独立与自信正面展开

本题最易在此维失分的是续写偏离主旨、去谈反面。达标要点是全程扣住 helps foster their independence and boost their confidence 的正面论证，例子直接指向独立判断与自信积累。

结构连贯三段清晰＋衔接词到位

本题达标要点是首句后有桥接、主体段有主题句、结尾有重申升华，配合 To begin with / In this way / As a result 的显性衔接，逻辑一望可辨。

语言准确关键词同义替换＋搭配无误

本题在此维的加分处是把 explore、learn on their own 转写成 try, fail, and try again、rely on his own judgment 等地道搭配，既呼应首句又不逐字复读。

字数格式首句不计＋正文落在区间

本题硬约束是 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words 且 not including the sentence given，自查时以首句之后的正文为准，确认既不低于下限也不超上限。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

改写了首句

反面示例把首句写成 Parents today know that giving kids freedom is good for them.——这是改写、不是照抄，直接失分。修正：开头必须原样写 Nowadays parents are increasingly aware that allowing kids more freedom to explore and learn on their own helps foster their independence and boost their confidence.

把首句算进字数导致正文太短

反面示例正文只补了七八十个词就收尾，作者以为加上首句已经够 150。修正：从首句之后重新数，确保续写部分自身达到下限，不足就再补一个例子或一层分析。

转去谈过度自由的坏处

反面示例主体段写 However, too much freedom makes children spoiled and out of control，把论点扭向反面，与首句脱节。修正：主体段应继续论证自由带来的独立与自信，如 A child who solves problems on his own gradually learns to trust his own judgment.

通篇口号无支撑

反面示例写 Freedom is good. Independence is important. Confidence is necessary for everyone. ——三句都是口号、无支撑。修正：换成一个具体经历，如 When my cousin was allowed to check his homework himself, he slowly stopped fearing new problems，用细节把观点撑起来。
