items.title: 2023年12月六级第3套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society." You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society. Far from being a burden, seniors possess a lifetime of professional knowledge and practical wisdom that younger generations simply have not had time to acquire.

This potential shows itself in countless ways. Take retired engineers and doctors as an example: many of them return to their former posts as consultants, training newcomers and solving problems that puzzle less experienced staff. In my own community, retired teachers volunteer to run free evening classes, while elderly craftsmen pass down traditional skills that would otherwise disappear. Such efforts prove that age brings not decline but a rich resource waiting to be tapped.

Therefore, we should stop regarding old age merely as a time of rest and instead recognize its true worth. If society creates more opportunities for the elderly to share their expertise, everyone benefits. Only by valuing and drawing on their skills and experience can we build a wiser and more harmonious community.

outline.content: With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society. Far from being a burden, seniors possess a lifetime of professional knowledge and practical wisdom that younger generations simply have not had time to acquire.

This potential shows itself in countless ways. Take retired engineers and doctors as an example: many of them return to their former posts as consultants, training newcomers and solving problems that puzzle less experienced staff. In my own community, retired teachers volunteer to run free evening classes, while elderly craftsmen pass down traditional skills that would otherwise disappear. Such efforts prove that age brings not decline but a rich resource waiting to be tapped.

Therefore, we should stop regarding old age merely as a time of rest and instead recognize its true worth. If society creates more opportunities for the elderly to share their expertise, everyone benefits. Only by valuing and drawing on their skills and experience can we build a wiser and more harmonious community.

items.referenceExplanation:
凭借宝贵的技能与经验，老年人能够继续为社会做出重要贡献。老年人远非负担，他们拥有一生积累的专业知识与实践智慧，而这些是年轻一代还来不及积累的。

这种潜力体现在方方面面。以退休的工程师和医生为例：他们中许多人以顾问身份重返原岗位，培训新人，解决经验不足的员工搞不定的难题。在我自己的社区里，退休教师志愿开办免费夜校，老手艺人则把原本会失传的传统技艺传承下去。这些付出证明，年龄带来的不是衰退，而是一笔有待挖掘的丰厚资源。

因此，我们应当不再把老年仅仅看作歇息的时光，而要认识到它真正的价值。倘若社会为老年人创造更多分享专长的机会，人人都会从中受益。唯有珍视并善用他们的技能与经验，我们才能建成一个更智慧、更和谐的社群。

【第 1 段】照抄首句加对比托举。首句 With their valuable skills and experience... 一字不差照抄，守住硬约束；紧接 Far from being a burden, seniors possess a lifetime of professional knowledge... 用对比句托举论点，落实了'照抄首句加一句托举'的方法与'对比托举观点'句架。

【第 2 段】双例并列回扣中心。主题句 This potential shows itself in countless ways 领起，Take retired engineers and doctors as an example 与 In my own community 两个钩子分别带出职场例和身边例，末句 Such efforts prove that age brings not decline but a rich resource 把例子拉回中心， 正是'先主题句再举例收束'的落地。

【第 3 段】推结论并升华呼应。Therefore, we should stop regarding old age merely as a time of rest 由前文推出态度，末句 Only by valuing and drawing on their skills and experience can we build... 用倒装升华并让 skills and experience 重现，与首句首尾呼应，落实'由论点推呼吁再升华'。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

论证老年人凭技能经验贡献社会

本题要写 an essay that begins with the sentence，且首句已给定：老年人凭 valuable skills and experience 能继续为社会做贡献。核心任务不是泛谈尊老，而是论证'为什么/怎样'老年人靠其技能与经验对社会有实实在在的贡献，并用 You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay 三种方式之一把这个论点撑起来。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

本题是纯议论大作文，没有具体收信人，不需要称呼、落款或书信格式。语域按面向阅卷人的正式书面英语来写：用完整句、正式词汇，避免口语缩略和随意语气，让论证显得客观、有分量。

中心立意

老人以技能经验持续回馈社会

中心论点就是给定首句：老年人凭借宝贵的技能与经验，能够继续为社会做出重要贡献。全文都为证明这一点服务，紧扣 With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society 中的技能、经验与贡献，不滑向养老、孝顺等偏题方向。

要展开的要点

1. 专业本领返聘再用

第一个要点从职场角度切入：退休的工程师、医生、教师等把多年积累的专业本领带回岗位， 做顾问、带新人、解决年轻人处理不了的难题，说明技能没有随退休作废，反而是稀缺资源。

2. 阅历传承服务社区第二个要点从社区与家庭角度切入：老人凭人生阅历做志愿服务、开公益课、传授传统手艺， 把经验转化为对身边人的实际帮助，呼应 use your personal experiences to develop your essay 里鼓励的个人经历式论证。

3. 社会应正视善用老人价值

第三个要点上升到态度层面：社会不该把老年只当作歇息期，而应创造机会让老人分享专长， 善用这笔财富，与首句首尾呼应、把论点收束成呼吁。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段照抄首句并点明立场

第一段逐字照抄给定首句作为文章开头，再补一两句解释老年人为何是资源而非负担， 把中心论点立稳。

第 2 段举例论证展开分论点

第二段是主体，用 cite examples 与 use your personal experiences 的方式，把'专业返聘''社区传承'两个要点各配具体事例展开，证明技能经验的实际价值。

第 3 段重申升华回扣首句

第三段收束：呼吁社会正视并善用老年人价值，回扣首句，把论点从'能贡献'升华到'社会应善用'。

第 1 段立老人是资源非负担

落点：先照抄 With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society，再点明老年人拥有年轻一代来不及积累的专业知识与人生智慧，是可被利用的财富而非社会累赘。

对比托举观点 · Far from being ___, they possess ___ that ___.（⽤'远⾮……⽽是拥有……'把负⾯预期翻转成正⾯价值）

补足原因 · ___ that younger generations simply have not had time to ___.（⽤⼀个 that 从句解释这项优势为何独属⽼年⼈）

第 2 段返聘与社区两例撑论点

落点：退休工程师、医生返岗当顾问、带新人、解决难题；社区里退休教师开免费夜校、老手艺人传授濒临失传的技艺。用这两组具体事例呼应 cite examples 与 use your personal experiences to develop your essay，证明年龄带来的不是衰退而是资源。

举例过渡 · Take ___ as an example: many of them ___.（⽤'以……为例 '把抽象论点落到⼀群具体的⼈⾝上）

亲历式补例 · In my own community, ___ volunteer to ___, while ___ pass down ___.（⽤亲⾝⻅闻再补⼀个例⼦，双例并列增强说服⼒）

例后回扣中心 · Such efforts prove that ___ brings not ___ but ___.（⽤'这些做法证明……'把例⼦拉回论点、避免脱节）

第 3 段呼吁社会善用老人专长

落点：社会不应把老年只当歇息期，而应创造机会让老人分享专长；唯有正视并善用他们的技能与经验，才能建成更智慧、更和谐的社群，回扣 With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society。

据证据下结论 · Therefore, we should stop ___ and instead recognize ___.（⽤ '因此我们应停⽌ ……转⽽认识到 ……'从论证推出态度）

条件式升华呼吁 · Only by ___ can we build ___.（⽤ '唯有 ……才能 ……'的倒装把论点拔 ⾼成呼吁，句末重现主题词呼应⾸句）

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题紧扣技能经验贡献

本题达标要点：全篇紧扣 With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society，用具体贡献说话；最易失分处是写成空泛的'尊老敬老'或跑到养老、孝顺话题。

结构连贯总分总加钩子词

本题达标要点：首段立论、次段双例、末段呼应，符合 make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay 的展开逻辑；易失分处是例子和论点之间没有过渡句，读起来像堆砌。

语言准确常用词写准比堆大词强

本题达标要点：contribute to、pass down、draw on 等搭配用准即可显出功底；易失分处是为求'高级'硬造中式表达，如把'做贡献'写成 make devote 之类的错搭。

字数格式卡150到200且首句原样

本题硬约束：正文须落在 You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words 的区间内，且开头逐字照抄给定首句；易失分处是字数越界或把首句改写、漏抄。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

改写首句致跑题

反面示例：把首句改成 Old people are useful and can help society a lot.（既改写又口语化，丢了 valuable skills and experience 这一核心）。修正：开头一字不改地写 With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society. 再展开。

只喊重要无例支撑

反面示例：Elderly people are very important. Their experience is valuable. Society needs them very much.（三句同义反复、没有一个例子）。修正：改成 Take retired doctors as an example: many return as consultants and train younger staff. 用具体事例把'重要'坐实。

漂到赡养孝顺话题

反面示例：We should respect the old and take good care of them. Children must support their aged parents.（讲的是被赡养，与'凭技能经验贡献社会'相反）。修正：改成 The elderly can give back through their skills, such as mentoring newcomers and passing down traditional crafts. 把重心拉回'贡献'。

items.title: 2023年3月六级第1套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “People are now increasingly aware of the danger of ‘appearance anxiety’ or being obsessed with one’s looks.” You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
People are now increasingly aware of the danger of ‘appearance anxiety’ or being obsessed with one’s looks. This uneasiness rarely appears out of nowhere. Bombarded daily by filtered images and narrow aesthetic standards on social media, many young people measure themselves against unreachable models and feel that they never look good enough. The constant comparison quietly drains their confidence and even distracts them from things that truly matter.

Yet a healthier attitude is well within our reach. The key is to shift attention from the mirror to inner value — our knowledge, kindness and abilities. I once spent hours worrying about a small scar before a presentation, until a friend reminded me that the audience remembered my ideas, not my face. That moment taught me that self-acceptance, rather than a flawless appearance, is what sets us free.

In short, looks are only a thin surface of who we are. Once we learn to value character over appearance, ‘appearance anxiety’ loses its grip, and we can live with genuine confidence.

outline.content: People are now increasingly aware of the danger of ‘appearance anxiety’ or being obsessed with one’s looks. This uneasiness rarely appears out of nowhere. Bombarded daily by filtered images and narrow aesthetic standards on social media, many young people measure themselves against unreachable models and feel that they never look good enough. The constant comparison quietly drains their confidence and even distracts them from things that truly matter.

Yet a healthier attitude is well within our reach. The key is to shift attention from the mirror to inner value — our knowledge, kindness and abilities. I once spent hours worrying about a small scar before a presentation, until a friend reminded me that the audience remembered my ideas, not my face. That moment taught me that self-acceptance, rather than a flawless appearance, is what sets us free.
In short, looks are only a thin surface of who we are. Once we learn to value character over appearance, ‘appearance anxiety’ loses its grip, and we can live with genuine confidence.

items.referenceExplanation:
如今人们越来越意识到'容貌焦虑'或过度在意自己外表的危害。这种不安很少凭空产生。每天被社交媒体上的滤镜图片和狭隘的审美标准所包围，许多年轻人拿自己与遥不可及的模板相比，觉得自己怎么看都不够好看。这种持续的比较悄悄消耗着他们的自信，甚至让他们分心，忽略了真正重要的事情。然而，一种更健康的心态其实触手可及。关键在于把注意力从镜子转向内在价值——我们的知识、善良与能力。我曾在一次演讲前为一道小疤痕焦虑了好几个小时，直到一位朋友提醒我：观众记住的是我的想法，而不是我的脸。那一刻让我明白，让人自由的是自我接纳，而非完美无瑕的外表。总之，外表只是我们身上薄薄

的一层。一旦我们学会看重品格胜过容貌，'容貌焦虑'便失去了它的掌控力，我们也就能带着真正的自信生活。

【第 1 段】抄首句并下钻成因。首句逐字照抄给定句，紧接 'This uneasiness rarely appears out of nowhere.' 承接，再用 'Bombarded daily by filtered images...' 展开成因、'The constant comparison quietly drains...' 点出危害，落实'承接首句下钻'与 make comments。

【第 2 段】转折加经历落地。'Yet a healthier attitude...' 完成从问题到对策的转折，'I once spent hours worrying about a small scar...' 用具体经历兑现 use your personal experiences to develop your essay，末句 'self-acceptance, rather than a flawless appearance...' 回扣内在价值，正是'以例证代空喊'。

【第 3 段】比喻收束定立场。'looks are only a thin surface...' 定调，'Once we learn to value character over appearance...' 把看重内在与焦虑消退因果绑定，给出'所以怎样'的落点，落实'回扣中心收尾'。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

续写容貌焦虑议论文

本题任务动词是 write，写作对象是一篇 essay，且要求 begins with the sentence，即把给定首句 People are now increasingly aware of the danger of '容貌焦虑' 这句话续写成一篇完整议论文——就'容貌焦虑'表明态度并论证，而不是复述现象。展开手段题目也给了：make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences，三选一二即可。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

本题是纯议论 essay，没有具体收信人或身份设定，write an essay 默认面向阅卷人，用正式、 客观的书面语即可：不用称呼、不用落款，避免 gonna、a lot of 这类口语和缩写，保持第三人称为主、必要时用 I 引出个人经历。

中心立意

看轻容貌、看重内在

承接首句 being obsessed with one’s looks 的危害，把中心立成：容貌焦虑源于外部审美绑架，我们应把注意力从外表转向内在价值，学会自我接纳，才能摆脱它。这是一个鲜明可辩护的立场，避免只停在'焦虑很普遍'这种无态度的描述。

要展开的要点

1. 成因与危害焦虑从何而来、伤在哪里：社交媒体的滤镜图与狭隘审美标准让人不断比较，悄悄消耗自信、 分散精力。这一点回应 make comments 中'评论'的要求。

2. 理性应对

给出对策：把关注点从镜子转向知识、善良、能力等内在价值，用自我接纳代替对完美外表的追逐，并用一段个人经历佐证，落实 use your personal experiences to develop your essay。

3. 收束升华把立场收紧成一句：外表只是薄薄一层，看重品格胜过容貌，焦虑自然失去掌控力，让全文有明确落点而非戛然而止。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段抄首句+析成因危害开头逐字照抄给定首句，随即承接，点明'容貌焦虑'的成因（make comments）与隐性危害。

第 2 段给对策+个人经历

转折引出理性应对，用一段 personal experiences 让'关注内在'落地，避免空喊。

第 3 段重申立场升华

回扣中心，用一句凝练的结论收束全文。

第 1 段滤镜比较消耗自信

成因落到：被滤镜图和狭隘审美标准包围，年轻人不断与遥不可及的模板比较；危害落到： 这种比较悄悄消耗自信、分散对真正重要之事的注意力，兑现 make comments 的评论要求。

承接首句下钻 · This ___ rarely appears out of nowhere. （⽤ '这种 …并⾮凭空出现 '把话题接住，逼出下⽂成因）

由现象追成因 · Bombarded daily by ___, many ___ measure themselves against ___ and feel that ___.

点出隐性危害 · The constant ___ quietly drains ___ and even distracts them from ___.

第 2 段一次演讲的顿悟

经历落到：演讲前为一道小疤痕焦虑数小时，朋友提醒'观众记住的是你的想法而非你的脸'， 由此明白 self-acceptance 而非完美外表才让人自由——把 use your personal experiences to develop your essay 写实。

转折引出对策 · Yet a healthier attitude is well within our reach; the key is to shift attention from ___ to ___.

个人经历举证 · I once ___, until ___ reminded me that ___.

由例回扣观点 · That moment taught me that ___, rather than ___, is what ___.

第 3 段重品格则焦虑失效

结论落到：外表只是薄薄一层，一旦学会看重品格胜过容貌，'容貌焦虑'便失去掌控力，人能带着真正的自信生活——正面回应首句 being obsessed with one’s looks 的 danger。

比喻定调收束 · In short, ___ are only a thin surface of ___.

回扣主题升华 · Once we learn to ___, ___ loses its grip, and we can ___.

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题态度对策不可缺

本题必须就'容貌焦虑'给出明确态度与对策，并至少用 make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences 中的一两种展开，只复述现象即判内容不切题。

结构连贯首句后要有承接句

照抄的首句后必须紧跟一句承接（如 This... rarely appears out of nowhere），第二段用 Yet 转折，第三段用 In short 收束，三段各司其职。

语言准确话题词要用对

appearance anxiety、be obsessed with one's looks、self-acceptance、inner value、 aesthetic standards 等话题词用对能加分，但别硬塞、别拼错。

字数格式硬上下限加首句照抄

本题字数为硬性上下限（You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words），越界即扣分；且首句须逐字照抄、不可改写或省略引号内关键词。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

改写首句

反面：把开头写成 'Nowadays many people are worried about their appearance.'——这是自己重写，丢了给定首句。修正：原样照抄 People are now increasingly aware of the danger of ‘appearance anxiety’ or being obsessed with one’s looks. 一字不改。

有现象无态度

反面：整篇只罗列'很多人不敢素颜、拼命减肥、越来越自卑'，结尾停在'这真是个大问题'。修正： 加入对策句，如 We should shift our attention from the mirror to inner value and learn to accept ourselves.

空喊口号

反面：'We must be confident. We should love ourselves. Beauty is not important.' 三句都是空话。 修正：换成一次经历，如 Before a presentation I once worried about a small scar, until a friend reminded me that people remembered my ideas, not my face.

中式直译

反面：'Many people very care their face and body, this let them not confident.' 逐字硬译且句子黏连。修正：Many people care too much about their looks, which makes them less confident.

items.title: 2023年3月六级第2套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “People are now increasingly aware of the challenges in making a decision when faced with too many choices.” You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
People are now increasingly aware of the challenges in making a decision when faced with too many choices. Ironically, the abundance of options that was meant to empower us often leaves us hesitant, anxious and exhausted instead.

A personal experience makes this clear. Last semester, when I tried to pick an elective, the online system listed over sixty courses. I spent three whole evenings comparing descriptions, reading reviews and switching between tabs, yet I still felt uncertain and finally enrolled at random. The endless comparison drained my energy long before the real learning began, and it left me doubting whether I had chosen wisely at all.

The lesson I have drawn is not to fear choices but to tame them. Before browsing, I now fix two or three criteria that truly matter to me and ignore the rest. By narrowing the field in advance, I turn an overwhelming list into a manageable shortlist, and I make decisions faster and with far less regret. When choices multiply, a clear standard, rather than more comparison, is what sets us free.

outline.content: People are now increasingly aware of the challenges in making a decision when faced with too many choices. Ironically, the abundance of options that was meant to empower us often leaves us hesitant, anxious and exhausted instead.

A personal experience makes this clear. Last semester, when I tried to pick an elective, the online system listed over sixty courses. I spent three whole evenings comparing descriptions, reading reviews and switching between tabs, yet I still felt uncertain and finally enrolled at random. The endless comparison drained my energy long before the real learning began, and it left me doubting whether I had chosen wisely at all.

The lesson I have drawn is not to fear choices but to tame them. Before browsing, I now fix two or three criteria that truly matter to me and ignore the rest. By narrowing the field in advance, I turn an overwhelming list into a manageable shortlist, and I make decisions faster and with far less regret. When choices multiply, a clear standard, rather than more comparison, is what sets us free.

items.referenceExplanation:
如今人们越来越意识到，当面对太多选择时，做决定会遇到种种困难。讽刺的是，那些本应赋予我们力量的丰富选项，往往反而让我们犹豫、焦虑、疲惫不堪。

一段亲身经历便能说明这一点。上学期我想选一门选修课，选课系统列出了六十多门课。我花了整整三个晚上比较课程简介、翻看评价、在各个页面间来回切换，可仍然拿不定主意，最后随手选了一门。无休止的比较在真正的学习开始之前就耗尽了我的精力，还让我怀疑自己到底选得对不对。

我得到的教训不是害怕选择，而是要驾驭它。如今在开始挑选之前，我会先定下两三条我真正在意的标准，其余一概不看。通过事先缩小范围，我把一份令人不知所措的长清单变成一份可控的短名单，决定得更快，也少了许多后悔。当选择成倍增加时，让我们获得自由的，是一条清晰的标准，而非更多的比较。

【第 1 段】照抄首句＋一句点破反差。本段第一句原样照抄了给定首句 People are now increasingly aware of the challenges in making a decision when faced with too many choices，守住结构分底线；紧接的 Ironically, the abundance of options that was meant to empower us often leaves us hesitant, anxious and exhausted instead 正是‘点破反差’句架的落地，一句话把复述变成立场。

【第 2 段】一个例子讲到底。本段用 A personal experience makes this clear 引入，再以 over sixty courses、three whole evenings comparing 等细节铺陈，最后 The endless comparison drained my energy long before the real learning began 点出后果——一个选课经历讲透，把 the challenges in making a decision 落到具体的比较成本上，比堆空例子更有说服力。

【第 3 段】教训—办法—回扣收束。本段以 The lesson I have drawn is not to fear choices but to tame them 亮态度，用 I now fix two or three criteria… and ignore the rest 给出可操作办法，末句 When choices multiply, a clear standard, rather than more comparison, is what sets us free 回扣题眼 too many choices，首尾呼应完成结构闭环。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

写选择过多带来的决策困境

本题的核心任务是围绕给定首句 People are now increasingly aware of the challenges in making a decision when faced with too many choices 写一篇议论短文。题眼是 too many choices 造成的决策‘challenges’——要写的是‘选择太多反而更难抉择’这一困境，而不是泛泛的‘怎样做决定’或‘决定有多重要’。一句话钉死：论证选择过载给决策带来的麻烦，并给出应对态度。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

本题是纯议论大作文，没有具体收信人，写给阅卷人看即可，因此用正式、规范的书面语，不加称呼、不加落款；避免 gonna、kids 这类口语与缩写。允许 use your personal experiences，所以第一人称 I 讲亲身经历是被鼓励的，但叙述之外的说理句仍要保持书面腔调。

中心立意

选择越多反而越难抉择

中心立场：面对 too many choices 时，过多的选项不仅没让决策更轻松，反而带来犹豫、焦虑与后悔；明智的态度是学会给选择设标准、做减法，而非一味比较。

要展开的要点

1. 选项过载的真实代价

用一段亲身经历坐实弊端：选课系统列出几十门课，反复比较却越比越乱，耗尽精力还怕选错 ——把抽象的‘困境’落到看得见的比较成本与后悔感上，呼应 the challenges in making a decision。

2. 以设标准驯服选择

给出应对办法作为收尾要点：动手前先定两三条真正在意的标准、砍掉其余，把长清单收成短名单，从而更快、更少后悔地决定——回扣题眼给出建设性态度。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段抄首句＋亮立场

逐字照抄给定首句 People are now increasingly aware of the challenges in making a decision when faced with too many choices，紧接一句点破‘本该赋能的选项反而令人犹豫’的反差，把全篇中心立起来。

第 2 段个人经历论证代价

用一段亲身选课经历具体展开 the challenges in making a decision：比较耗尽精力、最终随手了事还怕选错，把选择过载的弊端写实。

第 3 段提对策＋回扣收束

从上一段的教训提炼应对办法（先设标准、做减法），并以一句回扣 too many choices 的话作结，给出建设性态度。

第 1 段首句＋点破选项反成负担

照抄 People are now increasingly aware of the challenges in making a decision when faced with too many choices，随后指出：本应赋予我们力量的丰富选项，往往让人犹豫、焦虑而疲惫，反差即立场。

点破反差亮观点 · Ironically, the ___ that was meant to ___ often leaves us ___ instead.（把‘选项 /⾃由 ’填进第⼀空， ‘帮助我们 /赋能 ’填第⼆空， ‘犹豫、焦虑 ’填第三空）

定调总起 · What seems like ___ can in fact turn into ___.（⽤‘看似 A、实为 B’的句式给全篇定下反差基调）

第 2 段选课经历坐实过载代价

讲一次选选修课的经历：系统列出几十门课，花几个晚上反复比较仍拿不定，最后随手选了一门；比较早已耗尽精力，还留下‘是否选对’的怀疑——具体化 the challenges in making a decision。

引入实例 · A personal experience makes this clear: ___.（冒号后填⼀句话概括这次经历的场景）

铺陈细节 · I spent ___ comparing ___, yet I still ___.（前两空填‘多少时间 /精⼒ ’与‘⽐ 较什么 ’，yet 后填 ‘仍然犹豫 /拿不定 ’）

点出后果 · The endless comparison ___ long before ___.（前空填‘耗尽了我的精⼒ ’， 后空填 ‘真正的收获开始之前 ’，点出得不偿失）

第 3 段设标准做减法并回扣题眼

提炼应对态度：与其无休止比较，不如动手前先定两三条真正在意的标准、砍掉其余，把长清单变短名单，从而更快、更少后悔地决定；结句回扣 too many choices 点明‘清晰的标准而非更多比较才让人自由’。

转入对策 · The lesson I have drawn is not to ___ but to ___.（前空填 ‘害怕选择 ’，后空填 ‘驾驭它 /为选择设限 ’，⽤ not…but… 亮出态度）

给出办法 · Before ___, I now fix ___ that truly matter and ignore the rest.（填 ‘开始挑选之前 ’与‘两三条标准 ’，展⽰可操作步骤）

回扣题眼收束 · When ___ multiply, ___, rather than ___, is what sets us free.（⾸空填‘选择 /选项 ’，中间填 ‘清晰的标准 ’，rather than 后填 ‘更多⽐较 ’，与⾸句的 challenge 呼应）

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题紧扣选项过多的困扰

达标要点是全篇都围绕 too many choices 造成的困境；最易失分处是写着写着滑成 ‘如何做出正确决定’，丢了‘选项过载’这个题眼。本范文用选课例子始终扣住‘选项多→ 难抉择’。

结构连贯三段各司其职并回扣首句

本题达标结构是‘首句立场—实例论证—对策收尾’三段；易失分处是通篇一段到底或结尾另起新话题。范文末句回扣 too many choices，与首句呼应，结构闭环。

语言准确叙述用过去时说理用现在时

本题易失分处是讲选课经历时时态飘忽。范文中 spent、enrolled 用过去时叙经历， fix、turn 用现在时讲当下做法，泾渭分明；用词精准而不生僻。

字数格式落在150到200硬性区间

本题要求 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，是硬性上下限，低于或超过都失分；无需称呼落款。自查时确认正文既没缺斤少两、也没超标注水即可。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

改写首句丢结构分

反面示例：把首句改成 Nowadays many people find it hard to choose among options.——这已不是原句，判为偏题丢分。正确做法：原样写出 People are now increasingly aware of the challenges in making a decision when faced with too many choices. 作为第一句，再往下展开。

通篇抽象喊口号

反面示例：Too many choices are bad. We must learn to choose. It is very important to make good decisions.——三句都是空口号，毫无说服力。改法：换成一个具体场景，如 Last semester, faced with over sixty electives, I compared them for three evenings and still chose at random. 用细节坐实观点。

写成如何正确决策

反面示例：整段大谈 To make a right decision, we should collect information and think carefully. ——这在教‘怎样决策正确’，丢了题眼 too many choices。改法：改写成 Faced with too many options, even careful thinking cannot stop me from second-guessing my choice. 把落点收回‘选项过多’。

items.title: 2023年3月六级第3套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “People are now increasingly aware of the ‘digital gap’ or challenges the elderly face in a digital world.” You can make comments, give explanations, or cite examples to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
People are now increasingly aware of the ‘digital gap’ or challenges the elderly face in a digital world. As technology reshapes daily life at a dizzying speed, many senior citizens find themselves left behind, struggling to keep pace with tools that younger generations take for granted.

This gap manifests itself in countless everyday scenes. For instance, an elderly man may stand helplessly before a restaurant that only accepts mobile payment, unable to scan the QR code. Similarly, when hospitals shift appointment booking online, or when a health code is required to enter public places, those unfamiliar with smartphones are effectively shut out. As a result, tasks that were once simple now become sources of anxiety and isolation.

In my view, no one should be excluded by the very technology meant to serve them. Therefore, families ought to patiently teach their parents digital skills, while service providers should retain user-friendly alternatives such as cash counters and manual registration. Only through such joint efforts can we bridge this gap and build a society that is inclusive of every generation.

outline.content: People are now increasingly aware of the ‘digital gap’ or challenges the elderly face in a digital world. As technology reshapes daily life at a dizzying speed, many senior citizens find themselves left behind, struggling to keep pace with tools that younger generations take for granted.

This gap manifests itself in countless everyday scenes. For instance, an elderly man may stand helplessly before a restaurant that only accepts mobile payment, unable to scan the QR code. Similarly, when hospitals shift appointment booking online, or when a health code is required to enter public places, those unfamiliar with smartphones are effectively shut out. As a result, tasks that were once simple now become sources of anxiety and isolation.

In my view, no one should be excluded by the very technology meant to serve them. Therefore, families ought to patiently teach their parents digital skills, while service providers should retain user-friendly alternatives such as cash counters and manual registration. Only through such joint efforts can we bridge this gap and build a society that is inclusive of every generation.

items.referenceExplanation:
人们如今越来越意识到‘数字鸿沟’，也就是老年人在数字化世界里所面临的种种挑战。随着技术以惊人的速度重塑日常生活，许多老年人发现自己被落在了后面，难以跟上年轻一代习以为常的各种工具。

这道鸿沟体现在无数日常场景中。比如，一位老人可能无助地站在一家只接受手机支付的餐馆前，却不会扫二维码。同样，当医院把挂号搬到线上，或者当进入公共场所需要出示健康码时，那些不熟悉智能手机的人实际上被挡在了门外。结果，原本简单的事情如今成了焦虑与孤立的来源。

在我看来，没有人应当被本该服务于自己的技术排除在外。因此，家人应当耐心地教父母数字技能，而服务提供方也应保留诸如现金收银台和人工挂号这类便利的替代方式。只有通过这样的共同努力，我们才能弥合这道鸿沟，建成一个包容每一代人的社会。

【第 1 段】首句照抄加顺接。开头 People are now increasingly aware of… 一字不差地照抄了给定首句，守住 begins with the sentence 的硬约束；随后 As technology reshapes daily life…, many senior citizens find themselves left behind 用顺接句把话题往下推，并把 the elderly 替换为 senior citizens 防重复——正是‘照抄首句再顺接’的落地。

【第 2 段】两三个场景写实鸿沟。本段先用 This gap manifests itself in countless everyday scenes 起总句，再用 For instance… 和 Similarly, when… 连举扫码支付、网上挂号、健康码三个画面，最后 As a result, tasks that were once simple now become sources of anxiety and isolation 收束，兑现了 cite examples，把抽象鸿沟写得可感。

【第 3 段】表态加双主体对策。In my view, no one should be excluded… 亮态度；Therefore, families ought to…, while service providers should… 给出家庭与服务方两条可操作对策；末句 Only through such joint efforts can we bridge this gap 回扣首句的‘digital gap’并升华收尾，落实了‘亮态度给对策’。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

续写老年数字鸿沟

本题是首句续写：正文开头必须原样照抄 People are now increasingly aware of the ‘digital gap’ or challenges the elderly face in a digital world. 这一句既是开头也是话题锁——全文只能围绕老年人在数字时代遭遇的‘数字鸿沟’与困境来写，谈它的表现、成因、影响或对策，绝不能滑向‘科技让生活更方便’这类无关主线。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

本题是纯议论短文，没有指定收信人或具体读者，因此不需要称呼、落款。语域按‘面向阅卷人的正式书面语’处理即可：用完整句、避免口语缩写与网络用语，态度客观。不必强行加设一个读者，那样反而偏离 write an essay 的文体定位。

中心立意

不该被技术抛下

本篇中心立场：老年人不应被本该服务他们的数字技术反而挡在门外，社会与家庭有责任帮他们跨过这道鸿沟。这个中心既承接了 People are now increasingly aware of the ‘digital gap’ or challenges the elderly face in a digital world.，又给后文的态度与对策留了落点。

要展开的要点

1. 鸿沟的真实表现第一个要点：把抽象的‘数字鸿沟’落成老人日常碰壁的具体场景，让读者看得见——这是 cite examples 这一展开手段的直接用武之地。

2. 被落下的原因与后果

第二个要点：技术更新太快、老人学习跟不上，导致原本简单的事变成焦虑与被隔离，这是 give explanations 层面的分析。

3. 家庭与社会的对策第三个要点：给出态度与解决办法——家人耐心教、服务方保留现金与人工窗口等替代方案， 回扣中心并收束全文。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段照抄首句点题原样搬入 People are now increasingly aware of the ‘digital gap’ or challenges the elderly face in a digital world.，再补一句把话题接住、暗示自己的立场。

第 2 段举例加析因

本段是主体：用扫码支付、网上挂号、健康码等具体场景把鸿沟写实，再点出‘技术太快、老人跟不上’的成因与被隔离的后果。

第 3 段表态给对策

亮明态度并给出家庭与服务方两方面的对策，最后一句回扣中心、呼吁一个包容各代人的社会，收束全文。

第 1 段接住鸿沟话题

抄完首句后，补写：技术以惊人速度重塑生活，许多老年人发现自己被落在后面，跟不上年轻人习以为常的工具。把首句里的‘digital gap’具体化为‘被落下、跟不上’，自然引出后文。

顺接推进 · As + 主谓（⼤背景） , many + 群体 + find themselves ___，⽤来在⾸句之后接⼀句、把话题往下推。空位填本题的 ‘技术⻜速发展 ’与‘⽼⼈被落下 ’。

同义替换指代 · 把 the elderly 换说成 senior citizens / older generations，避免开头就重复⽤词，空位按上下⽂选⼀个。

第 2 段扫码挂号健康码

落三个可感场景：老人站在只收手机支付的餐馆前不会扫码；医院把挂号搬到线上；进公共场所要出示健康码——不熟悉智能手机的人被挡在外面。再点成因：技术更新太快，原本简单的事成了焦虑与孤立的来源。

举例过渡 · For instance, + ⼀个具体的⼈在具体场景⾥遇到的困难。空位填 ‘⽼⼈在只收 ⼿机⽀付的餐馆前不会扫码 ’这类画⾯。

并列追加 · Similarly, when + 情形⼀, or when + 情形⼆, + 那类⼈被 shut out。⽤来⼀ ⼝⽓再补两个同类场景，空位填⽹上挂号、健康码。

结果收束 · As a result, + 原本如何 + now become + 负⾯后果。空位填‘原本简单的事如今成了焦虑与孤⽴的来源 ’。

第 3 段家庭教服务方留窗口

态度：没人该被本应服务自己的技术排除在外。对策：家人耐心教父母数字技能；服务方保留现金收银、人工挂号等友好替代方案。末句呼吁携手弥合鸿沟、建成包容每一代人的社会。

亮明态度 · In my view, no one should be ___ by ___。空位填 ‘被本应服务他们的技术排除在外 ’，⽤来表态。

分主体给对策 · Therefore, A ought to ___, while B should ___。⽤⼀句话让两个责任主体各担⼀条，空位填家庭教技能、服务⽅留⼈⼯窗⼝。

升华收尾 · Only through ___ can we + 动词 + ⼀个更⼤的⽬标。空位填 ‘这样的共同努 ⼒’与‘弥合鸿沟、建成包容各代⼈的社会 ’，把结尾抬起来并回扣⾸句。

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题咬死老年鸿沟

本题最易在此维栽跟头：话题被 People are now increasingly aware of the ‘digital gap’ or challenges the elderly face in a digital world. 死死框住，全文必须谈老人面对的鸿沟与困境，一旦滑成‘科技让生活更便利’就跑题。范文三段都围绕老人碰壁展开，切题稳。

结构连贯三段各司其职

范文按‘现象→析因举例→态度对策’分三段，段内用 For instance / As a result / Therefore 标明逻辑，呼应 make comments, give explanations, or cite examples 的展开思路，读来一气贯通。

语言准确换词也不能改题眼

替换时要守住题眼：the elderly、digital gap 可换同义说法，但不能把话题概念换偏。范文用 senior citizens、older generations 轮替指代老人，同时保留 ‘digital gap’ 这一核心措辞，兼顾多样与准确。

字数格式卡死上下限勿越界

本题字数是硬约束 You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，低于 150 或高于 200 都违规，须卡在区间内；且开头须是给定首句、正文清晰分三段。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

改写首句丢分

反面示例（把首句改了写）：Nowadays many people notice that old people have trouble using digital devices. —— 这就把必抄的首句改写了，直接触犯硬约束。正确做法：原样照抄 People are now increasingly aware of the ‘digital gap’ or challenges the elderly face in a digital world. 作为全文第一句。

口号无例证

反面示例（空喊）：The digital gap is a serious problem and everyone should pay great attention to it because it is very important. —— 全是判断没有例证，论证单薄。改法：换成具体场景，如 For instance, an elderly man may fail to scan a QR code when a restaurant only accepts mobile payment. 让鸿沟看得见。

逐字直译不地道

反面示例（逐字直译）：Old people cannot follow the technology and are put outside by it. —— follow the technology、put outside 都是硬译。改法：用地道搭配，如 The elderly struggle to keep pace with new technology and are shut out by it. 表达更准。

items.title: 2023年6月六级第1套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence "Today there is a growing awareness that mental well-being needs to be given as much attention as physical health." You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
Today there is a growing awareness that mental well-being needs to be given as much attention as physical health. For too long, we have measured a person's health only by the body, ignoring the mind that quietly suffers behind a healthy-looking face. Yet a troubled mind can be just as disabling as a broken leg, which is why the two deserve equal care.

My own experience convinces me of this. During my sophomore year, a close friend kept a perfect exercise routine but slid into deep anxiety before exams. He looked strong, so no one noticed until his grades and sleep collapsed. Only after he sought counseling did he truly recover. His story shows that neglecting the mind can undo all the benefits of a fit body.

Therefore, we should treat mental and physical health as two wheels of the same cart. Schools and workplaces ought to offer counseling as readily as gyms, and each of us should learn to talk about our feelings without shame. When the mind is cared for as much as the body, a person can be genuinely, fully healthy.

items.referenceExplanation:
今天，人们越来越意识到，心理健康需要得到与身体健康同等的关注。长期以来，我们只用身体来衡量一个人是否健康，却忽视了那颗在健康外表之下暗自受苦的心灵。然而，一颗被折磨的心灵和一条断腿一样能使人失能，正因如此，二者理应得到同等的照护。

我自己的经历让我确信这一点。大二那年，一位好友保持着近乎完美的锻炼习惯，却在考试前陷入了深深的焦虑。他看上去很强壮，因此在成绩和睡眠双双崩溃之前，没有人察觉。直到他去接受了心理咨询，才真正康复。他的故事说明，忽视心灵会抵消强健体魄带来的一切益处。

因此，我们应当把心理健康与身体健康当作同一辆车的两个轮子来对待。学校和职场应当像提供健身房一样便捷地提供心理咨询，我们每个人也应学会毫无羞耻地谈论自己的情绪。当心灵得到与身体同等的照护时，一个人才能真正地、完整地健康。

【第 1 段】照抄首句＋对比承接＋亮观点。本段落实了'首句照抄后接对比再表态'：开头逐字照抄给定首句，紧接着 For too long, we have measured a person's health only by the body 用对比承接现象， 再用 Yet a troubled mind can be just as disabling as a broken leg, which is why the two deserve equal care 以 just as...as 亮明'同等对待'的立场，完成了 outline 里第一段'照抄首句并承接点题'的功能。

【第 2 段】主题句领起＋叙例＋回扣。本段落实了'主题句领起再叙例后回扣'：My own experience convinces me of this 一句领起，随后用大二同学从健身达人到考前焦虑崩溃、经咨询才康复的完整事例展开，最后 His story shows that neglecting the mind can undo all the benefits of a fit body 把例子焊回中心，完成 outline 第二段'举例论证忽视心理之害'的功能。

【第 3 段】重申＋分层建议＋升华。本段落实了'重申立场再分层给对策'：Therefore, we should treat mental and physical health as two wheels of the same cart 重申立场，Schools and workplaces ought to offer counseling... and each of us should... 分社会与个人两层给做法，末句 When the mind is cared for as much as the body 升华收束，完成 outline 第三段'重申立场并给出做法'的功能。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

论证心理健康应与身体同等受重视

本题要写的核心命题在首句里已经点死：mental well-being needs to be given as much attention as physical health。全文只做一件事——论证'心理健康应当与身体健康被同等重视'，而不是泛泛谈'健康很重要'或只谈身体健康。凡是偏离'同等重视'这个比较关系的内容都算跑题。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

本题是纯议论短文，没有指定收信人或情境身份，因此不需要称呼语和署名，只需面向阅卷人写规范的正式书面语：避免 don't、can't 这类缩写和口语插入语，用完整句、书面连接词。六级作文这一档最忌讳的是把议论文写成聊天口吻。

中心立意

心病如身病，二者须同等对待

中心论点一句话：心理健康和身体健康同等重要，一个被折磨的心灵和一副受伤的身体一样会让人失能，所以社会与个人都应给心理健康与身体同样的关注，呼应首句 as much attention as physical health。

要展开的要点

1. 心病与身病一样致残

第一要点：说明为什么二者该'同等'——一个焦虑抑郁的心灵，其破坏力不亚于一条断腿，会侵蚀睡眠、学业与人际，因此心理不该被排在身体之后。这一点直接支撑 as much attention as physical health 里的'同等'。

2. 用个人经历坐实忽视之害

第二要点：用一个具体的个人经历或例子（如身体很棒却陷入焦虑的同学），坐实'只顾身体、 忽视心理'会带来的真实后果，把抽象论点落到画面上，正好用足指令允许的 cite examples or use your personal experiences。

3. 社会与个人共同补位

第三要点：给出态度与做法收束——学校、职场应像提供健身设施一样提供心理支持，个人也应坦然谈论情绪，让心理健康真正获得与身体同等的关注。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段照抄首句并承接点题

逐字照抄给定首句 Today there is a growing awareness that mental well-being needs to be given as much attention as physical health 作为开头，紧接着用一两句承接：指出长期以来人们只以身体衡量健康，而心病同样会使人失能，从而亮明'二者应同等对待'的立场。

第 2 段举例论证忽视心理之害

本段是论证主体，用一个个人经历或例子展开：一个身体状况良好却被焦虑压垮的人， 说明只顾身体、忽视心理会毁掉身体带来的一切好处。

第 3 段重申立场并给出做法

收束段：重申心理与身体应同等对待，给出社会（学校、职场提供心理支持）与个人 （坦然谈情绪）两个层面的做法，以'唯有如此才算真正健康'作结。

第 1 段长期只量身体，忽视暗自受苦的心灵

承接内容落到：长期以来人们只用身体来衡量一个人的健康，忽视了在健康外表下暗自受苦的心灵；而一个被折磨的心灵和一条断腿一样让人失能，这正是二者应获同等关注的理由， 呼应 as much attention as physical health。

以对比承接现象 · For too long, we have measured ___ only by ___, ignoring ___. （⽤ '⻓期以来我们只以 …衡量，却忽视了 …'承接⾸句现象）

用同等比较亮观点 · Yet ___ can be just as ___ as ___, which is why the two deserve equal ___. （⽤ just as...as 点出⼆者'同等'并给出理由）

第 2 段健身达人却因焦虑崩溃的同学

内容落到一个个人经历：大二时一位坚持规律锻炼、外表强壮的同学，在考试前陷入深度焦虑，因为看起来没事而无人察觉，直到成绩和睡眠崩溃，接受心理咨询后才真正康复——用足指令允许的 use your personal experiences，坐实'忽视心理会毁掉健身带来的一切好处'。

用经历领起论证 · My own experience convinces me of this. During ___, ___. （⽤ '亲⾝ 经历让我确信 '把个⼈事例领进来）

叙例后回扣论点 · His story shows that neglecting ___ can undo all the benefits of ___. （讲完例⼦⽤ '这说明 …'把它焊回中⼼论点）

第 3 段社会供支持、个人敢谈心

内容落到两条做法：学校和职场应像提供健身设施一样便捷地提供心理咨询；每个人也应学会不带羞耻地谈论自己的情绪。最后落到'当心灵与身体获得同等关照，人才能真正完整地健康'，收束呼应 mental well-being needs to be given as much attention as physical health。

承上作结重申 · Therefore, we should treat ___ and ___ as ___. （⽤ Therefore 承上重申，把两者放到同等位置）

分层给可操作建议 · ___ ought to offer ___, and each of us should ___. （⽤ '机构应…，⽽我们每个⼈应 …'分社会与个⼈两层给做法）

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题全篇必须咬住'同等'二字

本题达标关键是全程咬住 as much attention as physical health 里的'同等'关系：范文里 just as...as、equal care、two wheels of the same cart、as much as the body 反复扣'同等'，就不会滑成泛泛谈健康。最易失分处是把心理和身体并列罗列却不谈'该同等对待'。

结构连贯三段各司其职、路标分明

本题三段分别承担表态、论证、收束，段首 For too long / My own experience / Therefore 就是三个清晰路标；易失分处是把首句续写题里的首句单独成段，或三段功能重叠、都在重复'心理健康重要'。

语言准确同等比较句式是本题加分点

本题的加分句式是'同等比较'：as much as、just as...as、no less...than、equally important 都能精准表达'同等重视'，范文用了 just as disabling as、as readily as、as much as the body。易失分处是想用比较句式却写错结构（如 as...than、no less...as）。

字数格式落在硬区间且无缩写

本题字数是硬约束，须落在 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words 之间； 格式上是纯议论文，不需称呼与署名，但要避免 don't 这类口语缩写。易失分处是为凑字数把同一句意思换个说法重复写。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

把首句改写或复述

反面示例（改写首句，直接不合规）：'Nowadays, people increasingly realize that mental health is as important as our body.' 这偷改了给定首句、开头即失分。正确做法是原样照抄：Today there is a growing awareness that mental well-being needs to be given as much attention as physical health. 然后再往下承接。

两者并列却不谈同等

反面示例（并列罗列、不论证同等）：'Physical health lets us run and work. Mental health makes us happy. Both are good for us.' 这只是各说各的、没有'同等'的论证。应改成：A troubled mind can be just as disabling as a broken leg, so it deserves the same attention we give the body. 用 just as...as 把'同等'讲透。

只喊重视不给证据

反面示例（空喊口号）：'Mental health is very important. We must pay great attention to it. Everyone should care about their mind.' 三句都是口号、无支撑。应换成具体经历：a close friend kept a perfect exercise routine but slid into deep anxiety before exams, and only counseling helped him recover——用足 cite examples or use your personal experiences。

items.title: 2023年6月六级第2套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “When faced with differing opinions, we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument.” You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words(not including the sentence given).
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
When faced with differing opinions, we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument. In a world where people come from diverse backgrounds, disagreements are inevitable; yet how we handle them reveals our maturity. Rather than shouting others down or stubbornly clinging to our own views, seeking common ground through calm reasoning is always the wiser choice.

The reason is simple: friendly discussion invites cooperation, while quarrels only deepen the divide. Take the famous debates in scientific communities. When Darwin proposed his theory of evolution, opponents raised sharp objections, but progress was made not by insults but by patient argument and shared evidence. Similarly, in my own study group, a heated dispute over a project was resolved only after we sat down, listened to one another, and combined our ideas. Mutual respect turned rivals into partners.

In conclusion, differing opinions need not lead to conflict. If we approach them with an open mind, sound logic, and genuine respect, we can transform disagreement into understanding and reach a consensus that benefits everyone. This is not only a skill but a mark of a civilized society.

outline.content: When faced with differing opinions, we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument. In a world where people come from diverse backgrounds, disagreements are inevitable; yet how we handle them reveals our maturity. Rather than shouting others down or stubbornly clinging to our own views, seeking common ground through calm reasoning is always the wiser choice.

The reason is simple: friendly discussion invites cooperation, while quarrels only deepen the divide. Take the famous debates in scientific communities. When Darwin proposed his theory of evolution, opponents raised sharp objections, but progress was made not by insults but by patient argument and shared evidence. Similarly, in my own study group, a heated dispute over a project was resolved only after we sat down, listened to one another, and combined our ideas. Mutual respect turned rivals into partners.

In conclusion, differing opinions need not lead to conflict. If we approach them with an open mind, sound logic, and genuine respect, we can transform disagreement into understanding and reach a consensus that benefits everyone. This is not only a skill but a mark of a civilized society.

items.referenceExplanation:
面对不同的意见时，我们应当努力通过友好的讨论和合理的论证来达成一致。在一个人们来自不同背景的世界里，分歧不可避免；然而我们如何处理分歧，恰恰显露出我们的成熟。与其压制他人或固执己见，不如通过冷静的说理去寻求共识，这永远是更明智的选择。

道理很简单：友好的讨论邀来合作，而争吵只会加深隔阂。以科学界那些著名的争论为例。当达尔文提出进化论时，反对者提出了尖锐的质疑，但真正推动进步的不是谩骂，而是耐心的论证与共享的证据。同样，在我自己的学习小组里，一场因项目而起的激烈争执，只有在我们坐下来、互相倾听、把彼此的想法结合起来之后才得以化解。相互尊重把对手变成了伙伴。

总而言之，不同的意见不必导致冲突。如果我们以开放的心态、严谨的逻辑和真诚的尊重去面对它们，就能把分歧转化为理解，达成惠及每个人的共识。这不仅是一种能力，更是一个文明社会的标志。

【第 1 段】照抄首句加背景态度双句。开头逐字照抄给定首句 When faced with differing opinions... reasonable argument.，随即用 In a world where people come from diverse backgrounds, disagreements are inevitable 补背景、用 Rather than shouting others down... is always the wiser choice 亮态度，落实第一段‘照抄首句并亮明立场’的功能。

【第 2 段】理由加达尔文例加小组亲历。先用 The reason is simple: friendly discussion invites cooperation, while quarrels only deepen the divide 给理由，再以 When Darwin proposed his theory of evolution... 上名人例，用 Similarly, in my own study group 接亲身经历，末句 Mutual respect turned rivals into partners 小结回扣中心，兑现‘论证＋举例’的主体段功能。

【第 3 段】重申加条件句加点睛升华。以 In conclusion, differing opinions need not lead to conflict 重申，用 If we approach them with an open mind, sound logic, and genuine respect, we can transform disagreement into understanding 条件句复用首句关键词回扣，末句升华到 a mark of a civilized society，形成首尾闭环。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

论证遇分歧应友好讨论理性求共识

本题要写的是：围绕给定首句 begins with the sentence 展开，论证面对不同意见时，应通过友好讨论与讲道理来达成一致。中心不是‘观点为什么会不同’，也不是‘如何坚持自己’，而是紧扣‘用友好讨论＋理性论证去求得共识’这一态度。任务要求明确允许 make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay，即靠评论、举例、亲身经历把这个态度撑起来。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

本题是纯议论短文，没有具体收信人，读者就是阅卷老师，因此用正式书面语即可，不需要称呼语、落款或口语化表达。语域上避免 gonna、a lot of 这类口语词，多用书面连接词与完整句式，让文章显得有分量。

中心立意

友好讨论与讲理优于争吵与固执

全篇中心：面对分歧，与其争吵或固执己见，不如以友好讨论和理性论证寻求共识，这既高效又体现修养。这一句直接承接给定首句 When faced with differing opinions, we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument.，全文所有段落都为它服务。

要展开的要点

1. 讲理：友好讨论促合作争吵加深对立第一个分论点讲道理：友好讨论邀请对方合作，而争吵只会加深隔阂、把分歧变成对立。这是回答‘为什么这样做更好’，对应任务里的 make comments。

2. 举例：以科学论争或亲身经历佐证

第二个分论点用事例佐证：可援引科学界靠理性辩论而非谩骂推动进步的历史，或一段自己在小组讨论里靠倾听化解争执的经历，正好落实 cite examples or use your personal experiences。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段照抄首句并亮明立场

开头段：逐字照抄给定首句 begins with the sentence，再用两三句把它扩展成明确态度 ——分歧难免，但处理方式见修养，理性求共识优于争吵固执。

第 2 段论证加举例的主体段

主体段：先讲道理（友好讨论促合作、争吵加深对立），再用一个名人事例＋一段亲身经历佐证，落实 cite examples or use your personal experiences。

第 3 段重申态度并升华收束

结尾段：回扣首句，重申以开放心态、理性逻辑与相互尊重把分歧转化为理解，升华到文明社会层面，形成结构闭环。

第 1 段分歧难免但理性处理见修养

本段落点：抄下首句后，指出人来自不同背景、分歧不可避免，但处理方式反映成熟度；与其压制别人或固执己见，不如以冷静说理寻求共识。紧扣 reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument。

补背景句 · In a world where ＿＿, ＿＿ are inevitable; yet how we handle them reveals our ＿＿.（填 ‘⼈来⾃不同背景 ’‘分歧’‘成熟 /修养 ’）

亮态度取舍 · Rather than ＿＿, ＿＿ is always the wiser choice.（前空填要否定的做法如争吵固执，后空填你主张的做法如冷静说理）

第 2 段科学论争与小组经历双例佐证

本段落点：理由是友好讨论邀请合作、争吵加深隔阂；名人例可用达尔文进化论遭遇尖锐反对却靠耐心论证与共享证据取得进步；亲身经历可写小组因项目起争执，坐下来互相倾听、 整合想法后化解，让 Mutual respect turned rivals into partners，落实 cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay。

给理由 · The reason is simple: ＿＿ invites cooperation, while ＿＿ only deepen the divide.（填 ‘友好讨论 ’与‘争吵 ’）

举例过渡 · Take ＿＿. When ＿＿, ＿＿ was made not by insults but by ＿＿.（引出名 ⼈/历史事例并点出靠理性⽽⾮谩骂取胜）

接亲历并小结 · Similarly, in my own ＿＿, ＿＿ was resolved only after we ＿＿.（⽤相似结构把个⼈经历接上并回扣中⼼）

第 3 段以开放理性尊重把分歧化为共识

本段落点：重申分歧无需酿成冲突，若以开放心态、严谨逻辑与真诚尊重相待，就能把分歧转化为理解、达成惠及各方的共识，并升华为文明社会的标志，回扣首句 reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument。

总结重申 · In conclusion, ＿＿ need not lead to ＿＿.（填 ‘不同意⻅ ’与‘冲突 ’，呼应⾸句主题）

条件绑定升华 · If we approach them with ＿＿, we can transform ＿＿ into ＿＿.（前空填开放⼼态 /理性 /尊重，后两空填分歧 →理解）

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题紧扣友好讨论求共识不写成坚持己见

本题达标要点：全篇必须服务于 reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument；最易失分是跑去写分歧成因或如何固执己见，与核心态度背道而驰。

结构连贯首尾呼应且例子有过渡不堆砌

本题达标要点：结尾用 In conclusion 与条件句回扣首句形成闭环；两个例子间用 Similarly 过渡，避免并列硬堆而无衔接。

语言准确贴题词组用准且高级句型无错本题达标要点：用好 differing opinions、reach a consensus、reasonable argument、mutual respect 等贴题词组；举例的过去时（Darwin proposed、was resolved）与主张的一般现在时不要混用。

字数格式正文达标且首句照抄不计数

本题达标要点：给定首句须原样照抄且 not including the sentence given，因此正文要单独凑够 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words 的下限，切勿把首句算进去导致正文实际不足。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

空喊应该友好讨论无据

反面示例：‘We should have friendly discussion. Friendly discussion is good. We should not quarrel. Quarrel is bad.’ 通篇重复口号、零论证。改为：‘Friendly discussion is better because it invites cooperation; when Darwin faced fierce objections, progress came from patient argument rather than insults.’ 用理由＋事例把口号坐实。

误把首句算进导致正文缩水

反面示例：考生抄完 17 词的首句后只续写了约 135 词就收尾，自以为‘一百五十多词达标’。实则正文不足下限。修正：续写部分单独写满至少 150 词，首句只作篇首、不计入。

跑题去写观点为何不同

反面示例：主体段大篇幅分析‘人们观点为什么会不同——因为文化、教育、性格差异’，全然不提如何通过讨论求共识，偏离核心。修正：把落点从‘为何不同’转到‘遇到不同该如何友好讨论、理性论证以达成一致’。

items.title: 2023年6月六级第3套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence "It is widely accepted that an important goal of education is to help students learn how to learn." You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
It is widely accepted that an important goal of education is to help students learn how to learn. In my view, teaching learners to acquire knowledge on their own matters far more than simply filling their heads with facts, because the ability to learn lasts a lifetime.

The reason is that knowledge itself keeps changing, while the skill of learning does not. Consider two students: one memorizes every formula the teacher offers, and the other masters how to find, question and apply new information. When they leave campus and face problems no textbook has covered, the first often feels lost, whereas the second keeps growing. My own experience confirms this. In college I taught myself programming through online courses; what my teachers really gave me was not the code, but the confidence and method to explore an unfamiliar field by myself.

For these reasons, education should do more than deliver content. Once students truly learn how to learn, they hold a key that opens every door throughout their lives.

outline.content: It is widely accepted that an important goal of education is to help students learn how to learn. In my view, teaching learners to acquire knowledge on their own matters far more than simply filling their heads with facts, because the ability to learn lasts a lifetime.

The reason is that knowledge itself keeps changing, while the skill of learning does not. Consider two students: one memorizes every formula the teacher offers, and the other masters how to find, question and apply new information. When they leave campus and face problems no textbook has covered, the first often feels lost, whereas the second keeps growing. My own experience confirms this. In college I taught myself programming through online courses; what my teachers really gave me was not the code, but the confidence and method to explore an unfamiliar field by myself.
For these reasons, education should do more than deliver content. Once students truly learn how to learn, they hold a key that opens every door throughout their lives.

items.referenceExplanation:
人们普遍认为，教育的一个重要目标是帮助学生学会如何学习。在我看来，教会学习者自主获取知识，远比单纯往他们脑子里填塞事实更重要，因为学习的能力能受用一生。

原因在于，知识本身在不断变化，而学习这项技能却不会过时。设想两个学生：一个把老师给的每条公式都背下来，另一个则掌握了如何去查找、质疑并运用新信息。当他们离开校园、面对课本从未讲过的问题时，前者常常无所适从，后者却能不断成长。我自己的经历印证了这一点。大学里我通过网络课程自学编程；老师真正给我的不是代码本身，而是独自探索一个陌生领域的信心与方法。

因此，教育应当做的远不止传递内容。一旦学生真正学会了如何学习，他们便握住了一把能在一生中打开每一扇门的钥匙。

【第 1 段】抄句后即表态。首行逐字照抄题给首句，落实了『照抄破题』这条硬约束；紧接的 In my view, teaching learners to acquire knowledge on their own matters far more than simply filling their heads with facts 用『表态领起』句架亮出中心立场，完成第一段「抄句＋亮立场」的功能。

【第 2 段】对比与亲历砸实。The reason is that knowledge itself keeps changing 先给道理， Consider two students: one ... the other ... 用『对比举例』句架把两类学生的差距摆出，My own experience confirms this 起的自学编程段用『个人自证』句架落地——正好用上题目允许的 cite examples 与 personal experiences 两种发展方式，兑现「对比＋自证展开」。

【第 3 段】因果收束加比喻。For these reasons, education should do more than deliver content 用 『因果收束』回扣中心，末句 they hold a key that opens every door 用『比喻升华』把观点拔高，短促有力，完成「回扣＋升华」的收尾功能。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

续写议论文谈会学习

任务是就一句给定的话续写一篇议论文——文章须 begins with the sentence 那句论断，并紧扣其中 an important goal of education is to help students learn how to learn 这一核心，把 「为什么教会学生如何学习很重要、如何做到」讲透，而不是泛泛去谈教育的其他功能。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

本题没有具体收信人，是一篇纯议论大作文，无需称呼与署名；用面向阅卷人的正式书面语即可，可用第一人称表达个人观点（题目允许 use your personal experiences），但整体语域保持中性偏正式，不用口语缩写堆砌。

中心立意

会学习胜过被灌输

中心论点：教育的价值不在于把现成知识塞进学生脑袋，而在于让他们掌握自主学习的能力 ——因为知识会过时，学会学习的能力却能受用终身。这正是对首句 an important goal of education is to help students learn how to learn 的顺承与深化。

要展开的要点

1. 知识会变能力不变原因论证：知识不断更新换代，而学会学习的方法不会过时；对比只会死记的学生和掌握了 「找信息、质疑、应用」方法的学生，走出校园遇到课本没讲过的问题时，后者才能持续成长。

2. 自学编程的亲身经历

个人经历佐证：题目允许 use your personal experiences，用「大学里靠网课自学编程」这一具体经历说明——老师真正给我的不是代码，而是独自探索陌生领域的方法与信心，让抽象论点落地。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段抄句＋亮立场

第一段：逐字照抄题给首句作开头，紧接一句表明自己的态度，点出「会学习胜过被灌输」这一中心，给全文定调。

第 2 段对比＋自证展开

第二段：主体论证段，先讲「知识会变、能力不变」的道理并作两类学生对比，再用自学编程的个人经历佐证，把中心论点撑满。

第 3 段回扣＋升华

第三段：因果收束，重申教育不应止于传授内容，用一个比喻把「学会学习」拔高为受用终身的钥匙。

第 1 段抄首句＋点出会学习更重要

照抄 It is widely accepted that an important goal of education is to help students learn how to learn，随后表态：教会学生自主获取知识，远比单纯往他们脑子里填事实重要，因为学习的能力能受用一生。

照抄破题 · （第⼀⾏逐字照抄题给⾸句，⼀字不加不改、不改写措辞）

表态领起 · In my view, ___ matters far more than ___, because ___.

第 2 段两类学生对比＋自学编程经历

先讲知识会过时而学习方法不会；再对比只会死记公式的学生与掌握『找信息、质疑、应用』方法的学生，走出校园后前者迷茫、后者持续成长；最后用大学靠网课自学编程的经历佐证——老师真正给的是独自探索陌生领域的方法与信心。

对比举例 · Consider two students: one ___, and the other ___. When ___, the first ___, whereas the second ___.

个人自证 · My own experience confirms this. In ___, I ___; what really mattered was not ___, but ___.

第 3 段重申＋比喻拔高

因果重申：教育应做的不只是传递内容；再升华：一旦学生真正学会如何学习，就握住了一把能在一生中打开每一扇门的钥匙。

因果收束 · For these reasons, ___ should do more than ___.

比喻升华 · Once ___, they hold a key that ___.

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题紧扣会学习不跑偏

本题最易在此丢分：题目锁定 learn how to learn，范文全程围绕「会学习 vs 被灌输」，未滑向泛谈教育的道德、就业等其他功能，切题达标。

结构连贯三段分明衔接显化

范文首段立论、二段论证、三段收束，职责分明；用 The reason is、whereas、For these reasons 等显化逻辑，衔接达标。

语言准确普遍现在个例过去

本题讲道理部分用一般现在时（knowledge keeps changing），叙述个人经历部分切换过去时（I taught myself），时态分工清楚，搭配如 acquire knowledge、apply new information 稳妥无误。

字数格式卡进区间且首句无改

本题硬性区间为 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，且须 begins with the sentence；范文落在区间内、开头逐字照抄，格式达标。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

擅自改写首句

反面示例把首句改成 It is well known that an important aim of education is teaching students to learn by themselves.（换词又改结构，已非原句）。修正：原样照抄 It is widely accepted that an important goal of education is to help students learn how to learn.

空喊重要无支撑

反面示例通篇如 Learning how to learn is very important. It is good for students. It helps a lot in our life.（三句都在重复「重要」却无一具体）。修正：补上对比与例子，如 A student who only memorizes formulas soon forgets them, while one who knows how to find and apply information keeps improving.

泛谈教育重要性

反面示例第二段写成 Education can help us find good jobs and become good citizens.（跑去谈就业与公民，离了「如何学习」）。修正：拉回主线，如 What education should really cultivate is the ability to keep learning after class ends.

items.title: 2024年12月六级第1套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “To increase the likelihood of success, one should set realistic goals and work persistently towards them." You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
To increase the likelihood of success, one should set realistic goals and work persistently towards them. This statement reveals a simple truth: ambition alone means little unless it is anchored to attainable targets and sustained effort.

A realistic goal keeps us moving instead of despairing. If a beginner runner vows to finish a marathon next week, failure is almost certain, and disappointment soon kills motivation. However, by aiming first at three kilometres, then five, and finally the full distance, the runner sets goals within reach and steadily raises the bar. Each small victory fuels the next.

Yet reasonable goals mean nothing without persistence. My cousin, who dreamed of passing CET-6, did not expect overnight fluency. She fixed a modest daily plan of thirty new words and one reading passage, and she stuck to it for months. As a result, she cleared the exam comfortably.

In this way, pairing sensible targets with steady work transforms a distant dream into a series of achievable steps. That is the surest road to success.

outline.content: To increase the likelihood of success, one should set realistic goals and work persistently towards them. This statement reveals a simple truth: ambition alone means little unless it is anchored to attainable targets and sustained effort.

A realistic goal keeps us moving instead of despairing. If a beginner runner vows to finish a marathon next week, failure is almost certain, and disappointment soon kills motivation. However, by aiming first at three kilometres, then five, and finally the full distance, the runner sets goals within reach and steadily raises the bar. Each small victory fuels the next.

Yet reasonable goals mean nothing without persistence. My cousin, who dreamed of passing CET-6, did not expect overnight fluency. She fixed a modest daily plan of thirty new words and one reading passage, and she stuck to it for months. As a result, she cleared the exam comfortably.
In this way, pairing sensible targets with steady work transforms a distant dream into a series of achievable steps. That is the surest road to success.

items.referenceExplanation:
为了提高成功的可能性，人应当设定现实的目标，并持续地朝目标努力。这句话揭示了一个简单的道理： 仅有雄心并无多大意义，除非把它锚定在够得着的目标和持之以恒的努力之上。

一个现实的目标能让我们不断前进，而不是陷入绝望。如果一个新手跑者发誓下周就跑完马拉松，失败几乎是注定的，随之而来的失落很快会浇灭动力。然而，如果先以三公里为目标，再到五公里，最后是全程，跑者就把目标定在了够得着的范围，并稳步抬高标准。每一次小小的胜利都为下一次积蓄动力。

然而，再合理的目标若没有坚持也毫无意义。我表姐一心想通过六级，她并不指望一夜之间就能流利。她定下一个不大的每日计划——每天三十个新词、一篇阅读，并坚持了数月。结果，她轻松通过了考试。

这样一来，把合理的目标与稳定的努力配对，就能把一个遥远的梦想化作一连串够得着的台阶。这正是通向成功最可靠的道路。

【第 1 段】抄句落地加立场。本段落实了‘抄句再亮立场’：首句 To increase the likelihood of success... 逐字照抄满足硬要求，紧接 This statement reveals a simple truth 一句把它转成自己的论点，并用 attainable targets 与 sustained effort 预告两条主线。

【第 2 段】主题句领起论证。本段落实‘主题句领起论证’：A realistic goal keeps us moving 亮观点，If a beginner runner vows... 与 by aiming first at three kilometres 一反一正给出例子，体现目标合理又逐级推进，末句 Each small victory fuels the next 小结回扣 realistic goals。

【第 3 段】转折递进举实例。本段落实‘转折递进举实例’：Yet reasonable goals mean nothing without persistence 用转折推进到第二个题眼；表姐 fixed a modest daily plan... stuck to it for months 让‘现实目标＋坚持’同时在场，As a result 收出结果，扣住 persistently。

【第 4 段】升华回扣中心。本段落实‘升华回扣中心’：In this way, pairing sensible targets with steady work 把两个题眼并到一句里概括升华，末句 the surest road to success 与首句 success 首尾呼应，未引入新论点。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

首句续写议论文

本题要写一篇以指定首句开头的议论短文：先 You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay，再围绕‘要成功须设定现实目标并持续努力’这一论点，用评论或例子把它论证充分。一句话钉死：抄首句 → 亮立场 → 论证‘现实目标＋持续努力’。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人正式书面语

本题无具体收信人、无身份设定，属纯议论大作文，读者就是阅卷人。因此不必写称呼与落款，只需通篇用正式书面语：不用缩写口语（don't、gonna）、不堆网络词，句式完整、语气客观。六级议论文在语域上失分多因掺口语，保持正式即可稳住这一维。

中心立意

现实目标加持续努力通向成功

本篇中心＝完全认同首句立场：成功不是靠空想，而是把目标定在够得着的范围内，再日复一日坚持，二者缺一不可。整篇都为证明‘realistic goals＋work persistently＝success’这条因果链服务。

要展开的要点

1. 现实目标让人走得下去

分论点一：目标定得现实可及，人才不会因遥不可及而放弃——扣住题眼 realistic goals。用跑步者从三公里、五公里到全程的例子，体现‘目标合理、逐级抬高’。

2. 持续努力让目标兑现分论点二：再合理的目标，没有 set realistic goals and work persistently towards them 里的 persistently 也是空谈——扣住题眼 persist。用备考六级者每天固定小任务、坚持数月的例子， 体现‘目标合理＋坚持到底’两点同时在场。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段抄首句加亮立场

逐字照抄给定首句，紧接一句承接句点明‘目标＋坚持缺一不可’的立场，为下文两个题眼开路。

第 2 段论证现实目标

主体段一：主题句亮出‘现实目标让人坚持得下去’，用跑步逐级加码的例子支撑 realistic goals。

第 3 段论证持续努力

主体段二：转折引出‘光有好目标不够，还得持续’，用备考六级每天坚持的例子支撑 persistently。

第 4 段收束重申中心

结尾段把两段例子概括升华，重申‘合理目标＋稳定努力＝成功’，回扣首句。

第 1 段抄首句加表态

正文第一句＝逐字照抄 To increase the likelihood of success, one should set realistic goals and work persistently towards them.；随后补一句：这句话点破一个简单真理——光有雄心不够，必须把它锚定在够得着的目标和持续的努力上。

承接首句转论点 · This statement reveals a simple truth: ___ means little unless ___.

预告两条主线 · It is only by ___ and ___ that ___ becomes possible.

第 2 段跑步逐级加码例

主题句：现实的目标让人不断前进而非绝望；理由：目标够得着，每次小胜都能续上动力； 例子：新手若发誓下周跑完马拉松必败，改为先三公里、再五公里、最后全程，就把目标控制在够得着的范围并逐级抬高。

亮明分论点 · A realistic goal keeps us ___ instead of ___.

举例过渡 · If ___, failure is almost certain; but by ___, ___.

小结回扣 · Each ___ fuels the next.

第 3 段备考六级坚持例

转折主题句：再合理的目标，缺了持续也白搭；例子：表姐想过六级，并不指望一夜流利， 而是定下每天三十个新词＋一篇阅读的小计划，坚持数月，结果轻松通过——目标现实、努力持续两点齐备。

让步转折推进 · Yet ___ mean nothing without ___.

个人经历引例 · My ___, who dreamed of ___, did not expect ___; instead, ___.

因果收束 · As a result, ___.

第 4 段两键并句升华

概括句：把合理目标与稳定努力配对，就能把遥远的梦想拆成一连串够得着的台阶；收尾句：这正是通向成功最可靠的路，呼应首句。

概括升华 · In this way, pairing ___ with ___ transforms ___ into ___.

呼应首句收尾 · That is the surest road to ___.

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题两题眼都要在场

本题最易只谈努力、丢掉现实目标这一半。达标要点：跑步段体现‘目标够得着＋逐级抬高’，六级段体现‘不奢望速成＋每日坚持’，两段都让 set realistic goals and work persistently towards them 的两个动作同时出现。

结构连贯转折词分开两键

本题两个主体段是递进关系，第三段用 However 或 Yet 起头能让阅卷人看清‘目标’与 ‘坚持’是两步而非重复；四段首尾用 This statement 与 In this way 呼应，连贯度更稳。

语言准确现在时讲理过去时叙例

本题讲普遍道理（keeps、mean nothing）用一般现在时，叙述表姐经历（fixed、 stuck、cleared）用过去时，两套时态别混。少数几个进阶词（anchored、 persistently）用对即可加分，不必强堆。

字数格式卡区间且抄准首句

本题有硬性上下限 You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，低于或超过都失分；同时首句必须逐字照抄，标点、大小写都不能改。写完先数字数、再逐字核首句，两关都过才交卷。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

改写首句失分

反面示例：把开头写成 To succeed, people need to set good goals and keep working hard.（换了词、丢了 realistic 与 persistently，等于没抄）。修正：原样照抄 To increase the likelihood of success, one should set realistic goals and work persistently towards them.

只讲努力丢目标

反面示例：Edison failed thousands of times but never gave up, so he succeeded.（只有坚持，没交代目标是否现实，扣不住 realistic goals）。修正：Edison set one workable target at a time and kept refining it through thousands of trials, which is how he finally succeeded.（补出‘现实目标’一面）。

空洞套话注水

反面示例：As we all know, in today's competitive society, success is very important for everyone, so we must try our best.（全是套话、不提目标与坚持）。修正：This statement reveals a simple truth: ambition alone means little unless it is anchored to attainable targets and sustained effort. （直接承接首句、点出两个题眼）。

items.title: 2024年12月六级第2套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence "Nowadays, more and more students have realized the importance of self-discipline in their personal growth." You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
Nowadays, more and more students have realized the importance of self-discipline in their personal growth. In an age flooded with short videos and endless distractions, the ability to control oneself has become the very foundation of academic success and character building.

A vivid example is my roommate Li Ming. When we entered university, he set himself a firm rule: no phone before finishing the day's study plan. While others drifted from one game to another, his steady self-management allowed him to master a difficult programming course and win a national scholarship. His experience convinced me that talent alone rarely decides how far a person goes; it is perseverance and daily self-control that truly shape our future.

Therefore, I firmly believe that cultivating self-discipline deserves our full attention. Rather than blaming the environment for our failures, we should learn to say no to temptations and stick to our own plans. Only by mastering ourselves can we grow into the people we truly wish to become.

outline.content: Nowadays, more and more students have realized the importance of self-discipline in their personal growth. In an age flooded with short videos and endless distractions, the ability to control oneself has become the very foundation of academic success and character building.

A vivid example is my roommate Li Ming. When we entered university, he set himself a firm rule: no phone before finishing the day's study plan. While others drifted from one game to another, his steady self-management allowed him to master a difficult programming course and win a national scholarship. His experience convinced me that talent alone rarely decides how far a person goes; it is perseverance and daily self-control that truly shape our future.

Therefore, I firmly believe that cultivating self-discipline deserves our full attention. Rather than blaming the environment for our failures, we should learn to say no to temptations and stick to our own plans. Only by mastering ourselves can we grow into the people we truly wish to become.

items.referenceExplanation:
如今，越来越多的学生认识到自律在个人成长中的重要性。在一个充斥着短视频和无尽干扰的时代，管住自己的能力已经成为学业成功和品格养成的根基。

一个鲜活的例子是我的室友李明。刚上大学时，他给自己定下一条铁律：当天的学习计划没完成，绝不碰手机。当别人从一个游戏刷到另一个游戏时，他稳定的自我管理让他攻克了一门很难的编程课，并拿到了

国家奖学金。他的经历让我确信：单凭天赋很少能决定一个人能走多远；真正塑造我们未来的，是毅力与日复一日的自我约束。

因此，我坚信培养自律值得我们全力以赴。与其把失败归咎于环境，不如学会对诱惑说不、坚持自己的计划。唯有掌控自己，我们才能成长为自己真正想成为的人。

【第 1 段】照抄首句＋一句点题。首段落实『首句当主题句破题』：开头一字不改照抄给定首句，第二句 In an age flooded with short videos and endless distractions... has become the very foundation of academic success and character building 用时代背景把抽象的『重要性』说实，定下全文基调。

【第 2 段】叙议结合的自律例子。第二段落实『例子叙议结合回扣』：A vivid example is my roommate Li Ming 引出例子，no phone before finishing the day's study plan 叙其自律，While others drifted... 作对比，末句 His experience convinced me that... 把例子回扣到『自律决定成败』的中心，并用了 self-management、perseverance、self-control 三个同义替换避免重复。

【第 3 段】重申＋建议＋倒装升华。第三段落实『重申加建议再升华』：Therefore, I firmly believe... 重申立场，Rather than blaming the environment... we should learn to say no to temptations 给出可操作建议，末句倒装 Only by mastering ourselves can we grow... 升华并呼应首句，形成闭环。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

论自律对成长的重要性

核心任务是就一句给定观点写一篇议论文——write an essay that begins with the sentence，而这句话把主题彻底钉死为『自律对个人成长的重要性』，即须原样照抄的 Nowadays, more and more students have realized the importance of self-discipline in their personal growth.； 随后用 You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. 里三种方式的一两种把它撑成整篇文章。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

本题没有具体收信人，属纯议论大作文，读者即阅卷老师，用正式书面语即可，不写称呼、不落款、不署真名。唯一的格式硬点是首句地位——You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.，它必须原样出现在文章最开头，而不是埋在段中当过渡句。

中心立意

自律是成长的根基

全篇中心一句话：自律是学业成功与品格养成的根基，尤其在充满诱惑的信息时代，能否管住自己往往决定一个人能走多远。这正是对首句 Nowadays, more and more students have realized the importance of self-discipline in their personal growth. 的顺承与坐实。

要展开的要点

1. 时代背景下自律更稀缺可贵短视频、游戏等诱惑遍地，能控制自己的能力反而成了稀缺品，从背景角度点明自律为何值得重视。

2. 具体例子证明自律决定成败

用一个身边人或亲身经历（如室友定规矩、坚持学习最终拿奖学金），落实 cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay，证明决定成败的是自律而非天赋。

3. 呼吁拒绝诱惑坚持计划结尾把中心推向行动：与其抱怨环境，不如学会对诱惑说不、坚持自己的计划，掌控自己才能成长。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段照抄首句并点题

原样照抄 Nowadays, more and more students have realized the importance of self-discipline in their personal growth. 作主题句，再补一句把『重要性』说成具体的『为什么重要』，定下全文基调。

第 2 段举例论证展开

用一个具体的人或亲身经历叙议结合，落实 cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay，证明自律如何带来成长。

第 3 段总结升华呼吁重申自律值得重视，给出可操作的建议，并升华回扣首句，形成首尾闭环。

第 1 段抄首句＋点出自律是根基

照抄首句后，补一句：在短视频与无尽干扰泛滥的时代，管住自己的能力已成为学业成功与品格养成的根基，从而把首句的『重要性』说实。

照抄首句破题 · 开头逐字搬⾸句，⼀字不改： Nowadays, more and more students have realized the importance of ___ in their ___.（原样照抄，不可改写）

点题定调 · In an age flooded with ___, the ability to ___ has become the very foundation of ___.（⽤背景衬托，把抽象概念落到具体）

第 2 段室友定规矩坚持终获奖学金

写室友立下『学习计划没完成不碰手机』的规矩，别人沉迷游戏时他靠 self-management 攻下难课、拿到国家奖学金，由此得出：决定人走多远的是 perseverance 与自律，而非天赋。

引出例证 · A vivid example is ___. When ___, he/she set himself/herself a firm rule: ___.（⼀句点名例⼦并交代背景）

对比反衬 · While others ___, his/her steady ___ allowed him/her to ___.（⽤别⼈反衬主⻆的⾃律成效）

由例回扣中心 · His/Her experience convinced me that ___; it is ___ that truly ___. （把例⼦拉回论点，防⽌叙议脱节）

第 3 段重申＋拒绝诱惑坚持计划＋升华

重申自律值得全力重视，建议与其把失败归咎环境，不如对诱惑说不、坚持自己的计划，升华到『唯有掌控自己，才能成为想成为的人』，呼应首句。

重申立场 · Therefore, I firmly believe that ___ deserves our full attention.（⼀句回扣中⼼，不引新论点）

给建议对策 · Rather than ___, we should learn to ___ and ___.（把道理落到具体⾏ 动）

升华呼应 · Only by ___ can we ___.（⽤倒装收尾，升华并呼应⾸句）

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题紧扣自律并用例子展开

本题必须始终围绕『自律对成长的重要性』，且用上 You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. 中的方式；最易失分处是写着写着跑去谈『努力』『时间管理』等相邻话题，偏离自律主线。

结构连贯三段清晰首尾呼应

本题达标要点是首段提出、中段证明、尾段收结分工清楚，且结尾 Only by mastering ourselves 呼应首句形成闭环；易失分处是通篇不分段或例子与结论之间缺过渡。

语言准确自律同义替换＋句式多样

本题应把 self-discipline 换用 self-control、self-management、perseverance 等避免全篇重复；六级层面还应有一两处像 Only by mastering ourselves can we grow 的倒装或从句提升语言分，但须确保正确、不为炫技牺牲准确。

字数格式控词数并原样照抄首句

本题硬约束是 You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. 且须 copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay；最致命的失分是漏抄或改写首句，其次是为凑字数注水或超出上限。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

改写首句直接扣分

反面示例（改写了首句）：These days, students increasingly think that self-control matters a lot for growing up.——这是改写、不是照抄，直接丢掉硬性分。正确做法是原样搬：Nowadays, more and more students have realized the importance of self-discipline in their personal growth. 放在开头一字不改。

空喊口号论证空洞

反面示例（空洞）：Self-discipline is very important. Everyone should have self-discipline. Without it, no one can succeed.——三句同义反复、无支撑。改成有细节的：My roommate refused to touch his phone until his daily study plan was finished, and this habit helped him win a scholarship.

同义重复凑字数

反面示例（注水）：Self-discipline is important. It is really important. We all know it is important for us.——三句没增加任何信息。改成推进式：Self-discipline is important because it turns vague goals into daily action, which is exactly what most students lack.

全篇重复一个词

反面示例（重复）：Self-discipline helps us study. Self-discipline helps us grow. Self-discipline decides our future.——通篇 self-discipline。改成轮换：Self-control helps us study, self-management helps us grow, and perseverance ultimately decides our future.

items.title: 2024年12月六级第3套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “College provides a great opportunity for students to explore various possibilities and find the right path for themselves.” You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
College provides a great opportunity for students to explore various possibilities and find the right path for themselves. Unlike the rigid routine of high school, the campus offers a wide range of courses, clubs and internships that allow us to test different interests and gradually discover where our true passion lies.

Take my own case as an example. When I entered university, I was convinced that I would become an accountant, simply because my parents thought it was stable. However, after joining a campus debate club and taking an elective in journalism, I realized how much I enjoyed writing and public speaking. That single semester of trying new things completely reshaped my plan, and I eventually switched my major to communication.

In my view, such freedom to experiment is exactly what makes college so valuable. Instead of clinging to a fixed idea, students should seize every chance to explore, because it is only through trial and error that we can truly find the path that suits us best.

outline.content: College provides a great opportunity for students to explore various possibilities and find the right path for themselves. Unlike the rigid routine of high school, the campus offers a wide range of courses, clubs and internships that allow us to test different interests and gradually discover where our true passion lies.

Take my own case as an example. When I entered university, I was convinced that I would become an accountant, simply because my parents thought it was stable. However, after joining a campus debate club and taking an elective in journalism, I realized how much I enjoyed writing and public speaking. That single semester of trying new things completely reshaped my plan, and I eventually switched my major to communication.

In my view, such freedom to experiment is exactly what makes college so valuable. Instead of clinging to a fixed idea, students should seize every chance to explore, because it is only through trial and error that we can truly find the path that suits us best.

items.referenceExplanation:
大学为学生提供了探索各种可能、找到适合自己道路的绝佳机会。不同于高中死板的作息，校园提供了丰富的课程、社团和实习，让我们得以尝试不同的兴趣，逐渐发现自己真正的热爱所在。

以我自己为例。刚上大学时，我坚信自己会成为一名会计，只因为父母觉得这份工作稳定。然而，在加入校辩论社、选修了一门新闻课之后，我意识到自己是多么热爱写作和公开演讲。那一个学期的种种尝试彻底重塑了我的规划，我最终转到了传播学专业。

在我看来，这种自由试验的空间，正是大学如此宝贵的原因。与其死守一个固定的想法，学生更应抓住每一次探索的机会，因为唯有经历试错，我们才能真正找到最适合自己的那条路。

【第 1 段】开头照抄＋对比引申。首段第一句逐字照抄了给定首句作主题句；第二句用 Unlike the rigid routine of high school 做对比引申，点出 courses, clubs and internships 三类探索平台，正是「首句起笔加引申」的落地。

【第 2 段】亲历试错的完整链条。主体段按「原打算当会计 → 参加辩论社、选修新闻 → 发现热爱写作演讲 → 转到传播」展开，是一条完整的试错定位链，用 Take my own case as an example 和 However 推进，把题目允许的 use your personal experiences 真正写实。

【第 3 段】回扣首句收束升华。结尾 In my view ... it is only through trial and error that we can truly find the path that suits us best 重申了「探索、找到路」的中心，与首句照应，全文闭环。

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意这道题到底要写什么 、 立意是什么

动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

核心任务

续写首句、论证大学的探索价值

本题是首句续写型议论文：开头必须逐字照抄 College provides a great opportunity for students to explore various possibilities and find the right path for themselves.，再围绕它展开。核心任务是论证「大学为什么是探索各种可能、找到适合自己道路的好机会」。要求写得很明确——You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay，抄漏一个词、改一个词都直接失分。

读者 · 语域

面向阅卷人的正式书面语

本题没有具体收信人，属纯议论大作文，只需用面向阅卷人的正式书面语：不写 Dear 称呼、 不堆口语缩写。题目允许 use your personal experiences to develop your essay，所以出现第一人称举例是被鼓励的，但整体仍要保持书面、客观的说理语气，不能写成聊天。

中心立意

自由探索让人找到适合自己的路

承接首句把中心一句话钉死：大学给了学生 explore various possibilities and find the right path for themselves 的空间，正是这种「试错—定位」的自由让它无比可贵。全文都为这个立场服务，不旁逸到无关话题。

要展开的要点

1. 平台丰富：大学是试错的舞台第一层要点：大学不同于高中的死板作息，提供课程、社团、实习等大量平台，让学生试探不同兴趣、逐步发现热爱所在——这是「探索可能」得以发生的物质基础。

2. 亲历试错：一次尝试改写了方向

第二层要点：用一段个人经历落实「探索—试错—定位」，例如原本以为要当会计，参加辩论社、选修新闻课后发现热爱写作与演讲，最终转到传播专业。具体经历比空喊口号有说服力。

3. 主动把握才有意义第三层要点：这种自由试验正是大学的价值所在，学生应主动抓住每一次探索机会，因为只有经历试错才能找到最适合自己的路——收束并升华。

S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段怎么分段 、 每段写什么 、 能套哪些句架

按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的功能句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。

第 1 段首句主题句＋引申立场照抄 College provides a great opportunity for students to explore various possibilities and find the right path for themselves. 作主题句，再引申一句，点出校园提供的探索平台，为下文铺路。

第 2 段个人经历论证探索试错

用一段亲身经历具体展示「探索—试错—定位」的过程，呼应题目 cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay。

第 3 段重申中心、呼吁把握机会

回扣首句，升华到「主动把握大学的探索机会」，让全文闭环。

第 1 段抄首句＋点出探索平台

开头逐字抄写 College provides a great opportunity for students to explore various possibilities and find the right path for themselves.，紧接一句引申：把大学与高中的死板作息对比，点出校园提供课程、社团、实习等平台，让人试探兴趣、逐步发现热爱所在。

照抄首句起笔 · 开头第⼀句＝把引号⾥的⾸句⼀字不差抄下（此为硬约束，不是句架空位） ：College provides a great opportunity for students to explore various possibilities and find the right path for themselves.

对比引申句架 · Unlike ___（对照物，如 the rigid routine of high school）, the campus offers ___（平台，如 a wide range of courses, clubs and internships）that allow us to ___（作⽤，如 test different interests）.

第 2 段从会计转到传播的试错经历

用一段个人经历落实「探索—试错—定位」：入学时以为要当会计，参加辩论社、选修新闻课后发现自己热爱写作与演讲，最终转到传播专业。这正是题目允许的 use your personal experiences to develop your essay。

举例过渡句架 · Take ___（对象，如 my own case）as an example. 或 In my own case, ___（把你的经历接上） .

转折推进句架 · I used to ___（原来的想法） ; however, after ___（做了什么尝试） , I realized ___（新的发现） .

第 3 段重申自由探索、呼吁把握机会

先一句看法：这种自由试验正是大学可贵之处；再一句呼吁：学生应主动抓住每一次探索机会，因为只有经历试错才能找到最适合自己的路——回扣首句里的 find the right path for themselves。

亮明看法句架 · In my view, ___（要肯定的东西，如 such freedom to experiment）is exactly what makes ___（对象，如 college）so valuable.

呼吁收束句架 · Students should seize every chance to ___（做什么，如 explore）, because ___（理由，如 it is only through trial and error that we can find the right path）.

R E V I E W · 自检避坑本题在四个评分维度怎样算达标 、 容易在哪丢分

按阅卷四维（内容切题 / 结构连贯 / 语言准确 / 字数格式）给出本题达标要点，并把最容易踩的低分写法摆出来 + 给改法 —— 这是写作版的「狠拆诱人错项」。

内容切题紧扣两个关键词不泛谈本题必须扣住 explore various possibilities and find the right path for themselves 两个关键词，别滑向泛谈大学生活。范文用换专业的例子直接对应「探索—定位」，就是切题的样子。

结构连贯三段顺承、信号词到位

范文三段分工清楚——平台、亲历、结论顺承推进，段内用 However、because 等衔接，读起来一气呵成，不是几句话硬拼。

语言准确搭配地道、句式有变化

本题易错点是逐字直译，如把「打好基础」硬译成 build good foundation。范文用 test different interests、trial and error 等地道搭配，长短句交错，读感自然。

字数格式守区间、开头照抄无抬头

本题是 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words 的硬区间，写完必须数词； 同时确认开头逐字抄了首句、没有加任何书信抬头。

典型低分写法 · 反面示例与改法

首句抄错或改词

反面示例：把首句写成 College provide a good chance for student to find their way.（漏了 provides 的 s、改了词、根本不是原句）。修正：一字不差地抄成 College provides a great opportunity for students to explore various possibilities and find the right path for themselves.

反复换说法重复首句

反面示例：连写三句 College is a place to try many things. College lets students find their way. College gives chances to explore.——三句都在换词复述首句，没有一个实例。修正：换成一段个人经历，如「我入学时以为要读会计，参加辩论社后转到传播」，用具体事实展开论证。

偏题泛谈大学好处

反面示例：整篇在写大学能交朋友、食堂饭菜好、社团气氛热闹，完全没扣「探索可能、找到适合自己的路」。修正：把内容收回到「尝试不同方向 → 定位适合自己的路」这条主线上，好处只作为探索的副产品带一句。

重复注水凑字数

反面示例：结尾写 So college is very very important and useful and helpful for everyone in many many ways.——靠堆砌形容词硬凑字数。修正：换成有信息量的收束，如 It is only through trial and error that we can find the path that suits us best.

items.title: 2024年6月六级第1套 · 写作
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “Nowadays, cultivating independent learning ability is becoming increasingly crucial for personal development.” You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. (You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.)
requirements: 围绕题目主题展开，论点清晰，举例具体
将题目给定句子放在文章开头
items.referenceEssay:
Nowadays, cultivating independent learning ability is becoming increasingly crucial for personal development. As knowledge updates at an unprecedented pace, the skills we master at school can no longer carry us through an entire career, which makes the capacity to learn on our own a decisive advantage.

To begin with, self-directed learning keeps us competitive. Those who can teach themselves new tools quickly adapt to changing workplaces, while those who wait to be taught inevitably fall behind. Take my own experience: when our university suddenly shifted to online courses, I taught myself data analysis through free tutorials, and that skill later helped me stand out in an internship. Moreover, lifelong learning nurtures independent thinking, enabling us to judge information critically rather than swallow it blindly.

In conclusion, independent learning is far more than an academic skill; it is a lifelong engine that drives personal growth. Therefore, we should consciously develop this ability and treat every day as a chance to learn.
